[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=nov2023_abs_em.uaqk5d&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20231127_PM2_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=4588%2E5257348%2Er48mWP ]Bradley Whitford

Hello Derek —
This is Bradley Whitford, who you may know as Commander Joseph Lawrence in
the Handmaid’s Tale. Or Josh Lyman in the West Wing.

But today, I’m emailing you as an American deeply concerned with the state
of our democracy.

When Donald Trump became President in 2016, the fictional world of Gilead
was starting to look a lot more realistic in America.

Demonization of immigrants, attacks on LGBTQ+ and women’s rights, and the
targeting of the press are just some of the ways that Trump’s America was
mirroring fiction on TV.

Flash forward to the 2024 election and Donald Trump is the GOP’s
frontrunner in the election. Again.

With the threat of Trump being elected, there’s no one I trust more in the
Senate to stand up to Trump – and for our democracy – than Adam.

I’ve spent years speaking out against Donald Trump and his MAGA lackeys
across the country. And some days, it can feel like it’s been literally
decades.

But while Trump tried to dismantle our democracy and destroy our
institutions, Adam was there, leading the resistance. Diving into the big
fights.

Holding Trump to account for his actions. Bringing truth to light. And
speaking out — loud and proud — against those who undermined our
Constitution. In fact, he still is today.

That’s why we need Adam Schiff in the Senate.

Because while Trump may no longer be president, his presence in our
politics is stronger than ever — with so many of his sycophants in the
Congress.

With Trump enablers like Ted Cruz, Ron Johnson, and Rick Scott in the
Senate, it’s more important than ever to have powerful, proven voices
speaking out against them in the chamber. That’s Adam.

We need champions in the Senate who will fight for voting rights, for
Supreme Court reforms, for action on the climate crisis, for reproductive
freedom, and for gun safety. That’s Adam.

We need someone who can stand up to the relentless MAGA attacks and come
out stronger, someone who can build a successful grassroots movement
capable of taking on Trump and his cronies. That’s Adam.

We must win this fight and elect Adam Schiff in California’s U.S. Senate
race. I need you to join me and add your support.

I’m personally asking you: [ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=nov2023_abs_em.uaqk5d&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20231127_PM2_V1_S1&email=&t=1005&akid=4588%2E5257348%2Er48mWP ]Will you make a contribution of any amount
to Adam’s U.S. Senate campaign today so that he can combat the MAGA
movement’s attacks, win this election, and lead the fight for progress in
the Senate?

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your
donation will go through immediately:

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2142?c0=nov2023_abs_em.5RW9ow&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20231127_PM2_V1_S1&email=&amount=3&t=1006&akid=4588%2E5257348%2Er48mWP ]EXPRESS DONATE

$100

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=nov2023_abs_em.uaqk5d&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20231127_PM2_V1_S1&email=&t=1011&akid=4588%2E5257348%2Er48mWP ]ANOTHER AMOUNT

I’ve always spoken up strongly for the causes and people I believe in, and
this U.S. Senate election is no different.

I am tired of seeing critical Senate legislation stifled by a filibuster
rule that doesn’t even appear in our Constitution. I am tired of the
paralyzing fear of inaction as there are more mass shootings, wildfires,
abortion bans, and attacks on our fundamental freedoms.

So I’m doing something about it, and I hope you’ll join me.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=nov2023_abs_em.uaqk5d&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20231127_PM2_V1_S1&email=&amount=3&t=1012&akid=4588%2E5257348%2Er48mWP ]Please, rush
$3 or
whatever you can spare to help Adam fight back against the MAGA movement’s
attacks, win this Senate race, and elect the Democratic majorities we need
in Washington to make the change happen.

It’s up to all of us to create the change we want to see — and I believe
that starts with helping Adam Schiff win this election in California.

Let’s not let America become Gilead.

Thank you,

Bradley Whitford

| | |
## Welcome to the MIGOP Newsletter!
Every Monday evening, you will receive new updates, helpful tips, legislative insights and more from the Michigan Republican Party! Want to share this newsletter with a friend? [Simply click here to open this edition in your browser.](https://mailchi.mp/c6adf4a66481/migop-newsletter-november-13-12664730?e=a2af77507c)
---
|
---
### Are You Free?
Thanksgiving is officially over, and Christmas is around the corner! Join fellow Republicans for the annual [MIGOP Christmas Party](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=2199bbfd21&e=a2af77507c) on December 12!

For more information about this and other upcoming events, visit the [MIGOP events page](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=233681fc8b&e=a2af77507c).
|
---
### **A Profile in Courage****: Ann Howard**
In Summer 2022, Michigan Secretary of State Jocelyn Benson launched a new assault in the Democrats ongoing war on election security. She published a new manual on "challengers’ rights," which flagrantly violated the law by placing poll challengers _under the authority_ of poll workers. (Think of this in baseball terms: pitchers having the final say on their own balls and strikes, not the umpires. Crazy!) And it rightly outraged a group of Michigan Republican poll challengers so much that they decided to do something about it. So, they filed a lawsuit against Benson. However, a problem soon became apparent. It was impossible for the plaintiffs to find an attorney with election law experience who would take their calls, let alone represent them! The threat of intimidation by prosecutors, of sanction by judges, and of firing by law firms outweighed whatever desire they may have for election security. Enter Ann Howard, a bankruptcy and real estate attorney from Southfield, Michigan. Ann had done some work on the Antrim case involving votes flipped from Trump to Biden in the 2020 election but had no formal training in election law nor any legal staff trained in that field. But she accepted the case—pro bono—and got to work in September 2022. In just one month's time, Ann had clearly gotten the attention of the Secretary of State, who called in reinforcements from the Elias Law Group, the infamous firm run by Marc Elias, the “Clinton’s lawyer” and formerly of Perkins Coie, the firm closely tied to the debunked “Russian dossier” hoax. Make no mistake. These were heavy hitters, and the fact that the firm sent two of its partners to help Benson signified how important winning this case was to Democrats not only in Michigan, but also elsewhere in the country. In October, Ann was getting deluged with 120-page “briefs” from the defendants' lawyers, demanding responses within mere hours of receipt. Fighting the flu, exhaustion, and the onslaught of paperwork, Ann persevered. “Adrenaline was running deep,” she says, “and we were on strict deadlines, so we just kept plowing forward.” Dogged determination and the sleepless nights finally paid off. In October 2023, the Michigan Court of Claims found in favor of the plaintiffs on all counts, thus preserving the rights of Michigan poll challengers! This was a huge victory for election security and a boon to patriots in the state and beyond. Ann encourages the Michigan Republican Party to continue seeking lawyers who are willing to secure elections: _Most attorneys aren't familiar with election law, which is fairly complex and difficult to navigate. However, with proper funding, we can train and pay attorneys so that they are ready for the 2024 election cycle._ **NOTE:** The Election Security Operations team at the MIGOP is actively seeking Republican volunteers for its 18 areas of responsibility in securing elections. For more information or to sign up, contact Phil O'Halloran at [phil@migop.org](mailto:phil@migop.org?subject=Election%20Security%20Operations%20Inquiry).
|
---
### Good Neighbor Program
Through the MIGOP Good Neighbor Program, you learn how important it is to be familiar with the U.S. Constitution and the Michigan Constitution—but designed specifically for engaged citizens throughout our state. **_That means you!_** These foundational documents outline the structure and functions of government at the federal and state levels—all which affects you, your neighbors, and your communities.

To learn more about the Good Neighbor Program, contact coordinators Ken Beyer (District 4 Chair) and Ann Clark (Wayne County Republican Committee Chair):
* [kenbeyer@protonmail.com](mailto:kenbeyer@protonmail.com?subject=Good%20Neighbor%20Program%20Inquiry)
* [annpatriot@protonmail.com](mailto:annpatriot@protonmail.com?subject=Good%20Neighbor%20Program%20Inquiry)

|

### Stay in the Loop on Wolverine State Legislation

For more information about this and other upcoming events, visit the . | A Profile in Courage: Ann Howard In Summer 2022, Michigan Secretary of State Jocelyn Benson launched a new assault in the Democrats ongoing war on election security. She published a new manual on "challengers’ rights," which flagrantly violated the law by placing poll challengers under the authority of poll workers. (Think of this in baseball terms: pitchers having the final say on their own balls and strikes, not the umpires. Crazy!) And it rightly outraged a group of Michigan Republican poll challengers so much that they decided to do something about it. So, they filed a lawsuit against Benson. The threat of intimidation by prosecutors, of sanction by judges, and of firing by law firms outweighed whatever desire they may have for election security. Enter Ann Howard, a bankruptcy and real estate attorney from Southfield, Michigan. Ann had done some work on the Antrim case involving votes flipped from Trump to Biden in the 2020 election but had no formal training in election law nor any legal staff trained in that field. But she accepted the case—pro bono—and got to work in September 2022. In just one month's time, Ann had clearly gotten the attention of the Secretary of State, who called in reinforcements from the Elias Law Group, the infamous firm run by Marc Elias, the “Clinton’s lawyer” and formerly of Perkins Coie, the firm closely tied to the debunked “Russian dossier” hoax. In October, Ann was getting deluged with 120-page “briefs” from the defendants' lawyers, demanding responses within mere hours of receipt. Fighting the flu, exhaustion, and the onslaught of paperwork, Ann persevered. “Adrenaline was running deep,” she says, “and we were on strict deadlines, so we just kept plowing forward.” Dogged determination and the sleepless nights finally paid off. | | Dear Peter, **It wasn’t long ago that The New York Sun, one of my favorite papers, became the exclusive publisher of my columns. ****In the short time that’s passed, the Sun’s mission has become more urgent than ever.****

**It’s been obvious to many of us for some time that journalism in our country has become corrupted.

More dangerous than the ideological implication is the fact that we’re left with precious few to hold our country’s most powerful institutions to account. Our justice system, law enforcement, universities, major corporations and government agencies have become politicized beyond recognition and act with impunity.

**The Sun is brave and relentless**. Every day it tackles head-on the most important issues facing our country. It truly holds the powerful to account.

It acts as a true newspaper should, in the service of traditional American values and the American people.

The Sun has a long history leading the charge. Its commitment to the finest journalistic standards goes all the way back to its founding in 1833.

The Sun is now growing at a rapid pace, but we’re up against some of the world’s largest media conglomerates. **To win, we need you to join us**. Every single person counts.

In the short time that’s passed, the Sun’s mission has become more urgent than ever. It’s been obvious to many of us for some time that journalism in our country has become corrupted. More dangerous than the ideological implication is the fact that we’re left with precious few to hold our country’s most powerful institutions to account. Our justice system, law enforcement, universities, major corporations and government agencies have become politicized beyond recognition and act with impunity. The Sun is brave and relentless. Every day it tackles head-on the most important issues facing our country. It truly holds the powerful to account. It acts as a true newspaper should, in the service of traditional American values and the American people. The Sun has a long history leading the charge. Its commitment to the finest journalistic standards goes all the way back to its founding in 1833. The Sun is now growing at a rapid pace, but we’re up against some of the world’s largest media conglomerates. To win, we need you to join us. Every single person counts. | | Join me and the Sun today in the fight to save American journalism. | [**NEW VIDEO: Citizens for Free Enterprise Outlines Priorities and Future Advocacy**](https://link.email.citizensforfreeenterprise.)
---
**PHOENIX, AZ** \- Citizens for Free Enterprise today outlined its priorities in a new video as it launches its mission to promote economic opportunity, fight socialism and protect the ideals guiding America’s economy. Citizens for Free Enterprise’s national advocacy effort will be committed to promoting the bedrock principles of our economic system that have empowered countless citizens to achieve the American dream.

**WATCH HERE...**
| [ ](https://link.email.citizensforfreeenterprise. "Our Mission")
---
“**Innovation, entrepreneurship and opportunity are at the heart of our economy - that’s the beauty of free enterprise,” says Citizens for Free Enterprise CEO and Former Arizona Governor Doug Ducey** in the video. “Citizens for Free Enterprise was established to promote opportunity, fight bureaucratic overreach and defeat big government socialism. The core tenets of the free enterprise system are under attack and our mission is to be the voice for those who want the next generation of Americans to have more opportunity.” As part of this national advocacy effort, Citizens for Free Enterprise will activate and mobilize concerned Americans who have previously been disengaged from politics but are passionate about expanding opportunity, protecting personal freedoms and preserving the American way of life.
“America’s economic system has been the single greatest engine of economic growth and mobility in world history,” said Citizens for Free Enterprise Executive Director J.P. Twist. “But the foundational principles that fuel our economy face threats from those who seek to tear it down and replace it with failed ideologies like socialism. Citizens for Free Enterprise will be taking its mission everywhere - Washington, D.C., state capitals, local communities and directly to voters across the country.”

body:
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=33841%2E3422442%2Eu6TpVq)
Derek,
These emails do something pretty powerful.
This isn’t BS. Online, grassroots fundraising allows people like me—a single mom of three who had no experience in politics prior to running in 2018—to compete against politicians who have spent decades climbing the ladders of Washington, collecting corporate checks. [**_So here I am, humbly asking via email for you to chip in $3, $7, or $20 before our end of month deadline on Thursday!_**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20231127-2?refcode=EMAN23_1_SDF_20231127_V1_F&refcode2=33841_3422442_u6TpVq&akid=33841%2E3422442%2Eu6TpVq)
Congress wasn't built for people like me. When I first got to Washington, I was the only single mom of school-age kids serving. There were groups like the Bourbon Caucus and the Beer Caucus—but not a caucus focused on lowering the cost of higher education.
And while at times that is frustrating, I didn’t come to Washington to play by the rules. **I came to Washington to shake things up, and that’s what I’ve been able to do thanks to the support of Porter Supporters like you.** With my whiteboard in tow, we’ve not only called out skyrocketing CEO pay and brought life to Congressional Hearings, but passed real legislation to lower drug costs, raise rates on polluters, and strengthen our economy.
Now, I’m running to take our fight to the U.S. Senate. Californians deserve a warrior fighting for them, not just their biggest donors—**and I’m proud to be the only candidate in this race who is rejecting both corporate PAC and federal lobbyist money.** But I won’t sugarcoat it—our campaign has been outraised every quarter so far.
With our end of month deadline just three days away, I’d be so grateful for anything you can give.
[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20231127-2?refcode=EMAN23_1_SDF_20231127_V1_F&refcode2=33841_3422442_u6TpVq&akid=33841%2E3422442%2Eu6TpVq)
Onward!
Katie Porter

Katie is running for the U.S. Senate because Californians deserve a warrior fighting for them in Washington. Our campaign is people-powered, we don’t take a dime from corporate PACs, federal lobbyists, or executives from Big Oil or Big Pharma. **[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-footer?refcode=EMAN23_1_SDF_20231127_V1_F&t=2&refcode2=33841_3422442_u6TpVq&akid=33841%2E3422442%2Eu6TpVq)**

As I mentioned last week, I'm often introduced as a global trend-watcher and analyst and regularly get asked questions about geopolitical and geo-economic developments. Lately, those questions have focused disproportionately on Russia/Ukraine, China/Taiwan, inflation, energy markets, housing markets, the US economy, and upcoming elections in Mexico, Taiwan and the United States. I'm also regularly asked about cryptocurrencies, gold, equity markets, and the US dollar.
To repeat from last week, "[Every now and then, I'm asked about my approach to making sense of the world (rather than my thoughts about what is currently happening). I love these questions as they provide an opportunity for me to describe the process I use to generate insights](https://substack.com/redirect/c1c51405-0c96-40ed-9cee-012309710848?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)." As a follow-up to the travelogue of three recent international trips that I shared last week in "[Travel Tales: Canada, UAE, Brazil](https://substack.com/redirect/c1c51405-0c96-40ed-9cee-012309710848?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)," I am going to share a bit about three domestic trips...
### Las Vegas, Nevada
In October, I attended the Forbes | Shook Top Advisor Summit, a gathering of some of America's leading investment advisors that took place in Las Vegas. While I had the opportunity to meet with several interesting investment managers (as well as [RJ Shook, founder of Shook Research](https://substack.com/redirect/b96185bc-9b1d-4de7-9134-a1217c189f29?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and the event organizer), I spent most of my time speaking with investors and management teams related to the space industry. Specifically, I met with the principals of [Balerion Space Ventures](https://substack.com/redirect/b4764453-f43d-4506-8b5f-04da71b9c0aa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), a space and defense technologies focused venture capital firm that I've been advising; Charles Miller, the co-founder and CEO of [Lynk Global](https://substack.com/redirect/a6c9cd18-b5ca-4afe-8283-c9d8fe81cd54?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), an innovative satellite services company that I've invested in; and Jim Cantrell and Mike D'Angelo, co-founders of [Phantom Space](https://substack.com/redirect/91ad3bb1-60f7-4ffd-83fd-c064d6f4e304?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), a launch company that's looking to become the "Henry Ford" of the new space industry by democratizing access to launch services.
**So What?**
My trip to Las Vegas spurred my thinking about a few different topics:
* On my way to Vegas, my flight flew over Lake Mead. As you can see from the picture above, water levels are well below historical levels as seen by the light-colored bands on the shorelines. But because I've flown over Lake Mead dozens of times in the past few years, what I noticed was that water levels seem to have been rising, which is in direct contradiction to [the prevailing narrative I had been hearing about ever falling water ](https://substack.com/redirect/a233a14d-5554-495d-add4-d829dee7e19e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)levels. Sure enough, [upon further investigation, water levels had in fact risen 22 feet in the past year, even if they remain below ideal heights](https://substack.com/redirect/af2c5913-8e9f-4113-bdd7-77469b3fd74b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Is this the start of a corrective process whereby water levels rise back to historically normal (whatever that means!) levels? Or is this merely a blip in the ongoing fall in Lake Mead's level?

The investment community's reaction to the Balerion, Lynk and Phantom stories was overwhelmingly positive with deep and genuine interest. Despite this enthusiasm, however, many of the largest investment advisors expressed concerned about the relatively small size of the space market today. They seemed content to watch the industry from the sidelines until it grew large enough to enable the allocation of significant capital. I interpreted this as a **massively bullish sign** **to invest in space today** as there appears to be a significant follow-on demand as the set of opportunities grow. Pardon the pun, but the industry's second stage booster seems ready to fire and will surely accelerate new space to new heights in due course.

### Chapel Hill, North Carolina
In late October, I joined Andrea Szigethy and her amazing team at the Academy for Institutional Investors in Chapel Hill, North Carolina for their Fall Investment Academy Forum. I had the opportunity to speak with a large audience of investment professionals from asset management firms, public pension funds, endowments, foundations, and family offices.
I spoke about the many cross-currents facing the world today. Yes, I spoke about inflation, but I also discussed [the risks of deflation](https://substack.com/redirect/7027d8f2-93fd-4028-a99c-608a94db9c6d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by highlighting the global outlook for demographics, technology and the supply of energy. I also spoke about the US-China War and [the various manifestations of the conflict visible in the world today](https://substack.com/redirect/dbfa6cef-3d37-487a-967d-463f7ae07c14?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) ([energy competition](https://substack.com/redirect/52aabb3e-f803-4fbe-974c-a2ec98bcecbb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [death of multilateralism](https://substack.com/redirect/25838eed-f378-4886-9c93-a78c9aa35e7a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [currency wars](https://substack.com/redirect/4951dd37-7425-4896-8d13-f4f479cfd75f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [the Israel-Hamas conflict](https://substack.com/redirect/0b036915-4933-46e3-b6e1-eb40961f969e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [the global food fight](https://substack.com/redirect/eecb6880-7cf7-410b-a11f-2f93bef49207?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and [other forms of influence operations](https://substack.com/redirect/1f918c3e-8842-4dfa-b4f2-be73dac53598?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)).
Interestingly, the topics that generated the most conversation after my presentation fell into three main buckets: (1) energy dynamics and whether technological innovation would make the current carbon focus look silly a few decades from now, (2) the bifurcating global economy and whether it was really possible for the US and China to decouple, and (3) the tensions between inflation and deflation in the short, medium, and long term.
**So What?**
A few insights from my trip to Chapel Hill:
* I found the timing of the inflation to deflation transition to be worthy of more consideration. While technology and demographics produce long run deflationary pressures, they are being offset in the short run by inflationary friend-shoring efforts. Further, as I noted in [my piece about the impact of rapidly rising mortgage rates](https://substack.com/redirect/62a856a1-c3e3-4883-ae1e-df04bf0a0b1d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), there are offsetting pressures that may lessen the deflation caused by falling real estate prices. With that said, the market is unlikely to have well-behaved incremental moves. Is it possible that we're going to have massive volatility in price levels? Could we have sticky inflation that persists until we hit a tipping point that pushes us rapidly into a vicious deflationary cycle? How might a political or social shift away from electrification impact the timing of a transition from inflation to deflation?
* Although I had spent some time during the conference speaking with attendees about the potential for technology to displace labor, I hadn't fully appreciated how the lack of labor may spur innovation. Yet that's exactly what I saw in action as I was leaving the conference to fly home and noticed the REEF [virtual food hall](https://substack.com/redirect/4bdd9825-3791-4843-8cde-a34823f15c4c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at the Raleigh Durham airport. By centralizing kitchen and service staff, the virtual food hall allowed patrons to purchase food from one of several restaurants and pick it up at a centralized locker. One of the managers who was running the virtual food hall shared the idea for REEF was driven in part by the need to overcome labor shortages (as well as a desire to give consumers more choice). Many of us focus on how technology can eliminate jobs, but could a shortage of workers spur innovation? What does this mean for a country like Japan that's facing what most analysts call a demographic time bomb? Could it mean Japan can incorporate job displacing technology without social unrest? Or might it even serve as a catalyst for Japan to turn into an innovation superpower? Are we thinking about technology and jobs correctly?

### Houston, TX
In November, I had the opportunity to visit a dredging job being run by Weeks Marine, a subsidiary of Omaha-based Kiewit. The scale and scope of the operations was enormous and it was stunning to learn of the specialized equipment used in the operation! And the folks running the project were among the most dedicated, professional and hard-working workers I have encountered anywhere in the construction industry.
I also had the opportunity while in Texas to run a small executive education seminar about behavioral biases and how they make us (as individuals and professionals) vulnerable to poor decision-making. After discussing how most of us are overconfident and let seemingly irrelevant data impact our thinking processes, I had the executives in the class head out into the real world to observe how marketers utilize these biases to nudge our behavior towards their objectives.
Lastly, and somewhat appropriately given the historical relationship between the US space industry and Houston, news broke that SpaceX was discussing a possible IPO of their Starlink satellite services business while I was in Texas. This led to several conversations with current and former NASA officials about implications of SpaceX's forthcoming Starship rocket lowering the cost of access to space even further.
**So What?**
Some insights from this trip:
* My time on the dredging vessels led to thinking about mining. As humans have already used many of the easiest-to-reach deposits of materials used to enhance the quality of our lives, will we have to begin mining the ocean? And surely doing so would be easier than mining asteroids, correct? The dredging efforts and this thinking reminded me of my [2020 prediction that raised the possibility that seabed mining would gain some traction](https://substack.com/redirect/3cc50c2c-c982-48a4-87f2-861b9bf36e0d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
> Although promising in concept, **[asteroid mining](https://substack.com/redirect/22f57b36-549a-4b7d-baff-cb9baf8a8a3f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ remains impractical](https://substack.com/redirect/22f57b36-549a-4b7d-baff-cb9baf8a8a3f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and fails to generate momentum; [seabed mining](https://substack.com/redirect/177782a4-8b61-4947-9ffc-3e60033a6850?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), however, gains significant traction as the [International Seabed Authority](https://substack.com/redirect/599f7207-42e0-4100-8628-f45f42d0bf7f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) continues [granting exploration permits](https://substack.com/redirect/6c8a4cc5-262a-461c-89ea-c0a1d1f234db?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and makes progress (with reluctant and qualified support from environmentalists) towards an **Underwater Mining Code**.
* One of the highlights of my trip to Texas was a dinner I had with several friends and clients at [eculent](https://substack.com/redirect/39acee1a-fe68-4c20-a4c7-55ef65db8400?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The restaurant has been called "One of the best restaurants in the world" despite its low profile. I had the opportunity to speak with Chef David Skinner about his multi-sensory approach to gastronomy. It was a fascinating conversation that led me to appreciate why the _Washington Post_ called him "A chef with a flair for the avant-garde [who] serves up three hours of sorcery." The dinner got me thinking about two big topics. First, America is blessed with having amazing talent everywhere. I simply couldn't stop thinking about the potential of the untapped talent we have outside of elite institutions and coastal cities. Second, the dinner validated my deep belief that we simply cannot fully appreciate or understand anything (including food) by solely relying on a single perspective. What Chef Skinner taught and demonstrated was that taste, appearance, texture, smell, and temperature all interact in complex ways to enhance our enjoyment of food.

### Wandering and Wondering
> _[As you can tell from a few of my most recent trips, I wander between industries, functions, geographies and topics. Along the way I collect all sorts of data that may prove useful, but also may be worthless. I think about what I observe and try to constantly incorporate my findings into an ever-evolving worldview. I also find this approach of](https://substack.com/redirect/c1c51405-0c96-40ed-9cee-012309710848?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[wandering and wondering](https://substack.com/redirect/c1c51405-0c96-40ed-9cee-012309710848?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ to be a fulfilling, interesting, informative, and fun way to generate insights.](https://substack.com/redirect/c1c51405-0c96-40ed-9cee-012309710848?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_
Because I remain convinced more than ever before that **each perspective is limited, biased and incomplete, I remain convinced** **the** **only hope we have to understand the dynamics driving our world today is to triangulate using many lenses**. Adopting a generalist perspective, an approach accessible to all of us, may very well be the most powerful tool we have to navigating uncertainty.

# FROM THE DESK OF LARRY KUDLOW
---
| | Dear Peter, **It wasn’t long ago that The New York Sun, one of my favorite papers, became the exclusive publisher of my columns. ****In the short time that’s passed, the Sun’s mission has become more urgent than ever.****

**It’s been obvious to many of us for some time that journalism in our country has become corrupted.

More dangerous than the ideological implication is the fact that we’re left with precious few to hold our country’s most powerful institutions to account. Our justice system, law enforcement, universities, major corporations and government agencies have become politicized beyond recognition and act with impunity.

**The Sun is brave and relentless**. Every day it tackles head-on the most important issues facing our country. It truly holds the powerful to account.

It acts as a true newspaper should, in the service of traditional American values and the American people.

The Sun has a long history leading the charge. Its commitment to the finest journalistic standards goes all the way back to its founding in 1833.

The Sun is now growing at a rapid pace, but we’re up against some of the world’s largest media conglomerates. **To win, we need you to join us**. Every single person counts.

| | | Right now, majestic gray wolves are being brutally murdered – including vulnerable young pups. **Three young gray wolves – some of the first wild-born pups in Colorado in over 80 years – were SHOT TO DEATH near the Wyoming border. **Now their last surviving pack members, and the future of wolves in the wild, are in extreme danger.
---
Cruel trophy hunters and their Big Polluter allies are feeding this tragedy. **Wolves can’t fight back against this coordinated effort to DECIMATE their packs and the lands they roam for “fun” and profits. That’s why Friends of the Earth is standing up to fight for our essential wildlife, the ecosystems they’re a part of and our planet.** But we’re counting on you to take action with us now, on one of our most important days of the year.

Hundreds of wolves were violently murdered in a matter of days!** Now, surviving wolf populations are still lacking critical protections, and the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (FWS) is failing to prevent more senseless slaughter.

That means, despite DECADES of tireless work, conservationists can’t protect our wolves and our public lands on their own. **Wolves who enjoy safety on one side of state lines can be MERCILESSLY TORTURED if they step into deadly, pro-hunting territory. The only way forward is to strengthen the Endangered Species Act (ESA). **
**But the fossil fuel industry doesn’t want that to happen.****The ESA is one of our strongest tools to PREVENT destructive drilling, mining and logging projects on the public lands vital species call home. An "insect apocalypse."
A "second Silent Spring."
A "catastrophic collapse of nature's ecosystems."

There’s no question that pollinator populations are rapidly spiraling. **Last year alone, the U.S. lost nearly HALF of all honeybee colonies.** And in just 20 years, one of our country’s most populous species of bumblebee, the Western Bumblebee, plummeted by 93%! The increased usage of toxic pesticides is making things worse.
The EPA has a chance to ban neonics once and for all. Instead, it might _**approve these pesticides for another 15 years**_. But there's still hope, Friend. Without access to these vital crops and a healthy diet, people could be at _**higher risk of heart disease, stroke, diabetes, and even cancer**_ , according to a recent study.
Without action, you and I could be part of the last generation to share the planet with many vital bee species.
At Friends of the Earth, we are doing everything we can to help save pollinators, protect our health, and stop the destruction of our planet. We're working to ban toxic pesticides that are driving the decline of bees and butterflies. At the same time, we're pushing major grocery companies like Kroger to stop selling food grown with these chemicals. With your help and membership support today, we can make a difference.
But the bees are running out of time -- **and they need you.**
If we don't stand up to Big Pesticide corporations now, **we could lose hundreds of wild bee species** in North America alone. It's up to us to help prevent a world without these vulnerable pollinators. Please, Friend, we need you by our side as we ramp up our efforts to save wild bees from extinction and protect our planet.

# TUESDAY, NOVEMBER 28, 2023
---|---

If everything feels more crowded, that's because it is. | | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father's cabin, and did not return until he could "give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight."
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly--plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That's why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **" Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry." **
Through** "Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,"** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.

clean_body: Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills | This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | | | Dear fellow American, Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid. While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law. Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father's cabin, and did not return until he could "give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight." By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly--plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun. That's why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic " Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry." Through "Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry," you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life. | | Now, the course is available in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or for use in a small group. You can receive the DVD box set as a thank-you for your tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Quantities of this special DVD box set are limited, so reserve your copy today. Dear Friends,

Join us next Tuesday, Dec. 5, at 6:30pm, at Great American Ranch, 13995 Raised Antler Cir. Midlothian, VA 23112, for the Chesterfield VA Tea Party.

Our special guest speakers this month are historians Ann McLean and Ted Lamb, who will be discussing the preservation of Virginia history, the history of public education in Virginia, and today's standards for teaching history in our commonwealth.

Plan to join us next week for what should be an informative and lively discussion. We hope to see you then.

For God & Country,
Amanda Chase

| | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father's cabin, and did not return until he could "give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight."
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly--plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That's why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **" Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry." **
Through** "Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,"** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.

Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...
Hillsdale accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

subject: Bad for manatees. Bad for the planet. Bad for you. Fight cruise pollution now with our Giving Tuesday MATCH
body:
| | | | | [](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/e_s17_main_cobrandedemail_c3)
---|---|---

| | | **BEFORE GIVING TUESDAY ENDS:
YOUR MATCHED GIFT IS NEEDED TO PROTECT OUR OCEANS, COMMUNITIES AND EARTH **
---
| | [RUSH A GIFT](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2151547?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
Brace yourself, friend, this is serious. Last year, almost **ONE-SIXTH of Florida’s manatee population was DECIMATED by starvation and pollution. 2023 is on track to be another deadly year for these gentle creatures, with over 400 manatees having already perished since January. **
**Mega-polluting industries like Big Cruise fuel this tragedy with reckless dumping and massive quantities of CO2 emissions.** Cruise ships are STILL allowed to dump filthy, contaminated wastewater – including toxic, acidic wastewater – directly into ocean habitats that are critical for vulnerable species! This harmful pollution feeds destructive algae blooms that kill manatees' primary food source, seagrass. No wonder manatee deaths are spiking from painful starvation!
**But it gets worse. **Cruise ships never stop running, even when they dock – and they’re powered by some of the dirtiest heavy fuel. **Every day, a mid-sized cruise ship emits as much particulate pollution as ONE MILLION CARS.** Coastal communities are trapped, breathing in this harmful pollution and suffering higher rates of respiratory diseases as a result.
**We MUST hold cruise companies and other Big Polluters accountable for the damage they cause. That’s why Friends of the Earth urgently needs your support before Giving Tuesday ends. ****That's because right now, a generous group of donors is MATCHING every gift up to $200,000 – and we’re counting on supporters like you to make the most of this match before it expires at midnight TONIGHT.**
[](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2151547?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
[_Please, before midnight: Will you make a membership gift of $27 or more – and have it DOUBLED – to help Friends of the Earth fight corporate greed and protect our oceans, our people and our only Earth?_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2151548?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

With pandemic travel restrictions lifted, **the cruise industry is BOOMING.** That means more ships – the size of city blocks – speeding through coastal waters and spewing their endless pollution. **The industry has grown so fast that governments have struggled to regulate it.** Greedy cruise companies have taken advantage of this situation, going beyond the huge quantities of LEGAL pollution to illegal dumping.
**Worse, some companies have SUED to block coastal communities from exercising their rights and protecting themselves from emissions-induced diseases! **No company should be able to take away our right to fight for our health and the health of our neighbors. For the sake of our oceans, our people and our planet, we MUST fight back.
**Friends of the Earth is standing up against the greedy cruise industry that prioritizes profits over human lives, helpless wildlife and the health of our planet. We are working to make sure proper regulations exist and are enforced for massive cruise ships.****Reaching our Giving Tuesday goal is critical to continuing this planet-saving work, and stopping ocean-wrecking, climate-destroying pollution from entering our ecosystems. But we rely on support from people like you, who understand how high the stakes are right now.**
**Please: We need your help to hit our goal and make the most of our rare Giving Tuesday match.**[Will you make your membership gift of $27 or more now – it will be MATCHED dollar for dollar – to help Friends of the Earth hold corporate polluters accountable and protect our oceans, our people and the only Earth we’ll ever get?](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2151548?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

Despite this imminent crisis, mainstream media remains silent... And our own government ignores dire warnings of industry experts like fourth-generation American farmers who warn: **_" Food shortages are coming."_** Imagine the panic of seeing empty grocery store shelves, not for a few days, but for several weeks or even months. name: 1600 Daily
subject: C.S. Lewis's Profound Insights
body:
C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life’s most important questions

| This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z8fotiqbl12kqrk6nk4sis590h6flddfi5b7m8u0_rp22sh2s8i6eo34chie4or6c1h2bs)
---
| | Dear friend, C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life’s most important questions through vivid language that is delightful and captivating to read.

His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more believers to renew and deepen their faith--making him the greatest Christian apologist of the twentieth century.

That’s why we produced “[**C.S. Lewis on Christianity,**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z137ntnoep2aeunbdf3p0urultq585oqot2q6jcg_rp22sh2s8i6eo34chie4or6c1h2bs)” which you can now own on DVD.
---
| [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zm3elck70jjkqdg29fnrega25a6ih2csael1jk4o_rp22sh2s8i6eo34chie4or6c1h2bs)
---
| | In this course you will learn Lewis’s profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis’s The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis’s Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis’s beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis’s own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

That’s why I hope you’ll join us in examining the eternal questions of Christianity with C.S. Lewis with [this beautiful new DVD box set](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zmnbeo48bc2n9db7cef6nkem6v4ksah2q810frq8_rp22sh2s8i6eo34chie4or6c1h2bs).

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, ’09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College
---

---

subject: Nearly 50% of honeybee colonies GONE?! Fight back now with our 2X MATCH
body:
| | | | | [](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/e_s17_main_cobrandedemail_c3)
---|---|---

| | | There’s no denying it: ** Bee populations are DROPPING in shocking numbers, and the consequences could be severe. Scientists are sounding the alarm – and warning of a catastrophic collapse of vital ecosystems **as insect populations decline.
---
**The Western bumblebee population has fallen by a staggering 93%. Over 700 types of North American bees are on the brink of EXTINCTION. Even honeybee colonies are declining at an alarming rate, with nearly 50% GONE just last year. But greedy corporations like Bayer are still polluting our farm fields – and contaminating the surrounding lands – by spreading MILLIONS OF POUNDS of bee-toxic pesticides. **
Our fragile bees don’t stand a chance against this senseless chemical onslaught. Meanwhile, the destructive and outdated pesticide industry continues to reap profits. **That’s why Friends of the Earth is fighting nonstop to protect our bees, our communities and our planet from harmful pesticide pollution and secure a sustainable future. But we need your help before Giving Tuesday ends so we can continue this urgent fight. **
**For today – and only today – a generous group of donors is matching all gifts up to $200,000 in honor of Giving Tuesday ****– ****but only until midnight TONIGHT. That means today only, you can DOUBLE YOUR IMPACT in this crucial work.[Please: Will you make a membership gift of $27 or more now – while $27 becomes $54! – to protect pollinators, people and our planet from Big Polluters?](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2152206?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)**

---
Here’s the shocking truth: Chemical companies play such a huge role in our farming system that **even the seeds of our major crops, like soy, are coated with neonics. Neonics are the most widely used insecticides WORLDWIDE.** But these chemicals are **NEUROTOXIC to bees** , and research clearly shows that neonics are key drivers of an “insect apocalypse.”
**As bee populations keep dropping, risks to our food system – and our very survival – will continue to rise.** Neonics contamination persists in our food, soil and water – spreading its toxic touch from our farm fields into the wider ecosystem and our homes. Even more,** recent rates of bee loss have already impacted fruit, nut and vegetable production across the globe. That means more people could lose access to vital nutritious foods as they become more expensive, increasing the risk of heart disease, stroke and other life-threatening conditions, according to a recent study. **
But that isn’t stopping pesticide corporations from keeping their death grip on our farming system. **They’re spending big money on major misinformation campaigns in a huge effort to deceive farmers and consumers, and hide their role in the bee die-offs! These tactics BLOCK the ecological farming solutions we need** to protect our pollinators, our communities and our planet for generations to come. We can’t step aside and let it happen!
**We MUST stop the pesticide industry from spreading their bee-toxic POISON and polluting our planet just for short-term profits. **Friends of the Earth is pushing food retailers to stop using neonics in their food supply, and groundbreaking policies that ban neonics and other harmful pesticides. **That’s why this $200,000 Giving Tuesday matching gift opportunity is so critical right now – and we need your help to get there before the deadline tonight. name: American Action News
subject: C.S. Lewis's Profound Insights
body:
C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life’s most important questions

| This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z7bid7qj96o95mjur7tevvt361e21vdoph621ego_rp22sh2s8i6eo34chie2ob2c3h2bs)
---
| | Dear friend, C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life’s most important questions through vivid language that is delightful and captivating to read.

His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more believers to renew and deepen their faith--making him the greatest Christian apologist of the twentieth century.

That’s why we produced “[**C.S. Lewis on Christianity,**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zb6ns5p66fdddlpm3n8cb545beepg2mcr0rid6mg_rp22sh2s8i6eo34chie2ob2c3h2bs)” which you can now own on DVD.
---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zd1jv4iavakhmj4v7koc75c9vupjtataujqcgis0_rp22sh2s8i6eo34chie2ob2c3h2bs)
---
| | In this course you will learn Lewis’s profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis’s The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis’s Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis’s beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis’s own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

That’s why I hope you’ll join us in examining the eternal questions of Christianity with C.S. Lewis with [this beautiful new DVD box set](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z2nddtkbdi6jptk54hufm3n99rlaa1gg5cuvjqi8_rp22sh2s8i6eo34chie2ob2c3h2bs).

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, ’09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College

## 5 Questions to Ask When Choosing a Financial Advisor
---
| The questions you ask can help ensure you find the financial advice to help you plan to achieve your goals.
---
| [Take Retirement Quiz](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c36189%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=rTV2vRF4el1MP%2bhDsocDNw&sysid=1 "Take Retirement Quiz")
---
| _Find up to three advisors that serve your area, free!_
---
| | | SPONSORED BY SMARTASSET
---
| [ ](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c36188%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=eKmb3P23jD%2f2ss6Q5S2fqQ&sysid=1)
---
|
---
| Whether you’re saving for retirement, considering major purchases, planning your estate, or just want a second set of eyes on your investments, hiring a financial advisor who you feel best suits your needs could be key. A 2022 Northwestern Mutual study found that 62% of U.S. adults admit their financial planning needs improvement. However, only 35% of Americans work with a financial advisor.1 The value of working with a financial advisor varies by person. While advisors are legally prohibited from promising returns, research suggests that people who [work with a financial advisor](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c36180%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=uB34trXyQRjeifZWUN2gZg&sysid=1) feel more at ease about their finances and could potentially end up with about 15% more money to spend in retirement.2 Whatever your reasons for seeking financial advice, it’s important to have a list of questions planned to ensure you’re hiring a financial advisor who can help you plan to reach your goals.
### **5 Questions to Ask When Choosing a Financial Advisor**
**1\. Are You a Fiduciary?** Fiduciaries are financial advisors with a legal obligation to prioritize your interests as they manage your assets or money. Unlike a broker who may push you into insurance policies or investments to rack up fees and commissions, fiduciaries are bound to recommend options that benefit you, the customer. While conflicts of interest can still exist, any potential conflicts of interest must be disclosed. SmartAsset's [free tool](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c36181%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=yGCDzyrlWLGuZ7tnJ4LwJg&sysid=1) will only match you with vetted fiduciary advisors. **2\. How Much Experience Do You Have?** In addition to asking about their professional certification, it can also be a good idea to ask a prospective financial advisor about their overall experience. Generally, the more experience they have the better, especially if your financial situation is complicated. You should consider asking about their education, previous employers and track record of success. You might also want to consider performing a background check to find out whether they’ve ever been convicted of a crime or been involved in a criminal investigation by a regulatory or trade group. Don’t be afraid to ask for references from current or previous clients, and be wary of a financial advisor who seems reluctant to provide this information. **3\. What Type of Services Do You Offer?** Some financial advisors offer a range of services, while others specialize in niche aspects of financial management. For example, some advisors may only handle investments, while others take a more comprehensive approach, including retirement, estate planning and tax planning, along with other services. Ideally, you should look for an advisor whose range of services most closely fit your current and future needs. It’s also helpful to ask whether they specialize in a specific type of client. Some financial advisors may cater to retirees while others may prefer to work with families or divorcees. Some advisors cater to high-net-worth clients. [Choosing an advisor](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c36182%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Ybm5LM55AM6q3wzx4LD8hg&sysid=1) who works exclusively with clients whose situations are similar to yours means they could be better equipped to offer the type of guidance and advice you may be seeking. **4\. What’s Your Fee Structure?** Before you sign on the dotted line, you need to know how much your prospective financial planner will charge for their services. Depending on the type of professional you’re working with, they may receive a flat or hourly fee, be paid on commissions, or a combination of both. Fee-based advisers, for example, charge an up-front fee, but may also get a commission for selling financial products. Fee-only advisors make money from the fees they charge their clients. Some fee-only advisors charge a flat rate while others charge by the hour. Advisors who cater to high-net-worth clients may calculate their fees based on a percentage of the assets under management. **5\. What’s Your Investment Approach?** You should also consider asking prospective advisors about their investing approach. If you’re not comfortable taking on a lot of risk, you could consider a financial advisor who advocates a more conservative strategy. Knowing whether or not their investment style matches your personal investing philosophy beforehand could potentially save you complications in the long run.
## **How to Find a Vetted Fiduciary Financial Advisor**
This is the biggest hurdle for many. With thousands of daily Google searches for "Fiduciary financial advisors near me," "best fiduciary financial advisor," and "financial investment advisors near me," the hunt for a vetted fiduciary advisor can feel like a wild goose chase. But it doesn't have to be. And thankfully, it really isn't. Our [free matching quiz](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c36183%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=baxqzZGYH3Fc0JMIGtw%2fVA&sysid=1) links Americans with up to three fiduciary financial advisors who serve their area so they can evaluate and choose the one who fits their needs. Advisors are rigorously vetted through our proprietary due diligence process and legally committed to acting in your best interest. It's never too late to work towards the path of financial freedom.

A 2022 Northwestern Mutual study found that 62% of U.S. adults admit their financial planning needs improvement. However, only 35% of Americans work with a financial advisor.1 The value of working with a financial advisor varies by person. While advisors are legally prohibited from promising returns, research suggests that people who feel more at ease about their finances and could potentially end up with about 15% more money to spend in retirement.2 Whatever your reasons for seeking financial advice, it’s important to have a list of questions planned to ensure you’re hiring a financial advisor who can help you plan to reach your goals. 5 Questions to Ask When Choosing a Financial Advisor 1\. Are You a Fiduciary? Fiduciaries are financial advisors with a legal obligation to prioritize your interests as they manage your assets or money. Unlike a broker who may push you into insurance policies or investments to rack up fees and commissions, fiduciaries are bound to recommend options that benefit you, the customer. While conflicts of interest can still exist, any potential conflicts of interest must be disclosed. SmartAsset's will only match you with vetted fiduciary advisors. 2\. How Much Experience Do You Have? In addition to asking about their professional certification, it can also be a good idea to ask a prospective financial advisor about their overall experience. Generally, the more experience they have the better, especially if your financial situation is complicated. You should consider asking about their education, previous employers and track record of success. You might also want to consider performing a background check to find out whether they’ve ever been convicted of a crime or been involved in a criminal investigation by a regulatory or trade group. Don’t be afraid to ask for references from current or previous clients, and be wary of a financial advisor who seems reluctant to provide this information. 3\. What Type of Services Do You Offer? Some financial advisors offer a range of services, while others specialize in niche aspects of financial management. For example, some advisors may only handle investments, while others take a more comprehensive approach, including retirement, estate planning and tax planning, along with other services. Ideally, you should look for an advisor whose range of services most closely fit your current and future needs. It’s also helpful to ask whether they specialize in a specific type of client. Some financial advisors may cater to retirees while others may prefer to work with families or divorcees. Some advisors cater to high-net-worth clients. who works exclusively with clients whose situations are similar to yours means they could be better equipped to offer the type of guidance and advice you may be seeking. 4\. What’s Your Fee Structure? Before you sign on the dotted line, you need to know how much your prospective financial planner will charge for their services. Depending on the type of professional you’re working with, they may receive a flat or hourly fee, be paid on commissions, or a combination of both. Fee-based advisers, for example, charge an up-front fee, but may also get a commission for selling financial products. Fee-only advisors make money from the fees they charge their clients. Some fee-only advisors charge a flat rate while others charge by the hour. Advisors who cater to high-net-worth clients may calculate their fees based on a percentage of the assets under management. 5\. What’s Your Investment Approach? You should also consider asking prospective advisors about their investing approach. If you’re not comfortable taking on a lot of risk, you could consider a financial advisor who advocates a more conservative strategy. **The presence of Eastern monarch butterflies in their wintering grounds DROPPED 22% in just the last year!**
Now, monarch butterflies are spending the winter in Mexico -- but come spring, their numbers as they return could reach abysmal lows. Monarch butterflies are at risk of dying off; some estimates show population declines of up to 95% since the 1990s!
What’s worse is that this didn’t have to happen. You see, **a key factor in their decline is toxic pesticides like Bayer-Monsanto's Roundup.** Stand up to Bayer-Monsanto and help save the monarchs before it's too late! [_**We need at least 8 more people from your area to make a $27 contribution before midnight tonight**_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2152871?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) if we are going to make a difference for monarchs, people, and our planet. And today you can double your impact with our rare Giving Tuesday match opportunity – your gift will be matched dollar for dollar, up to $200,000, but only until midnight TONIGHT!
Monarchs' migration patterns are uniquely impressive. They travel around 3,000 miles every year, providing invaluable pollination along the way. But in the last few decades, the use of herbicides like Roundup has grown dramatically. Roundup is killing off the only food monarch caterpillars depend on -- milkweed. **Without milkweed, it is nearly impossible for monarch young to hatch and survive.** But Bayer-Monsanto continues to mercilessly put its profits from Roundup over pollinators, people, and the planet.
Friends of the Earth is putting everything we have into protecting our ecosystems and our planet from toxic pesticides, but we need your support to make an impact.
**Don't let monarchs be driven to extinction: Donate $27 today and have twice the impact in our fight for pollinators, people, and the planet.**
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_

[Donate $100 immediately](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2152869?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
[Donate another amount](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2152870?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
The monarch butterfly's incredible migration can span hundreds to thousands of miles over five generations. Each generation knows its destination thanks to an internal "compass" the monarchs follow.
But pesticide companies like Bayer-Monsanto seem to lack a moral compass -- continuing to sell glyphosate, the key ingredient in Roundup, no matter the cost to our planet and these incredible creatures.
**The use of Bayer-Monsanto's Roundup increased by over 2,600%** from 1987 to 2016. This toxic weedkiller has virtually wiped out milkweed -- the only food source for young monarchs -- across the U.S.
And to make matters worse, a recent study highlighted a frightening fact: every single sample of milkweed collected was contaminated with pesticides -- **one-third with levels deadly to monarchs.** Young monarchs are hatching on toxic pesticide-riddled milkweed; their first meal may be their last.
The dangers don't end there, Friend. Glyphosate is a probable carcinogen. It is also associated with reproductive harm in humans, along with disruption of the gut microbiome, kidney toxicity, and fatty liver disease. _**Farmers and homeowners are suing Bayer-Monsanto due to high rates of non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma linked to the Roundup**_ they've used on their farms and lawns. Roundup is causing extensive harm that must be stopped before it's too late.
**Help us stand up to Bayer-Monsanto and protect our planet with your $27 gift, doubling your impact with our Giving Tuesday match. **
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_
[Donate $27 immediately](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2152867?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

When the greed of companies like Bayer-Monsanto comes at the expense of our health and our planet, the stakes are too high to wait a minute more to take action. **Monarch populations are in freefall -- the time to act is now, while there are still monarchs left to save.**
At Friends of the Earth, we are fighting on every front to save these pollinators. Friend, we need you by our side as we ramp up our efforts to protect monarchs, people, and our planet.
With each passing day, and as toxic pesticide use grows, we may only get the rarest glimpses of these beautiful butterflies. Future generations may never experience the beauty of seeing a monarch on a sunny day. body:
Are you an unapologetic Republican? | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/ne.gop/n41kepo7ku-12665373?e=25844e23a8)
---
| | [ ](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=df6d55f295&e=25844e23a8)
---
| |
#### Good Morning Republicans,

We all have some reading to do.

In 2020, the RNC had the opportunity to amend the Republican Party's Platform, but because of the challenges of 2020 Convention location and a small number of delegates attending, they resolved to not amend our "values". So the Republican Party's Platform IS actually from the previous National Convention of 2016 and boy...the 67 pages of Platform Values are __**prophetic**__. Remember, at the time, we as a nation were coming off of eight years of the Obama administration and its policies purposely designed on eroding the fabric of our great nation. However, when you take the time to dial down on the specifics of our [2016 Platform](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=3c6f2c7bc6&e=25844e23a8) and how it matches today's outcomes, we have to make a choice.

**We, as Republicans, need to decide once and for all that a Platform defines us in every capacity and governance level...not 80% of the time, and not just when it's convenient to win an election.** We must educate and become articulate in the exact definition of our Platform so we can become **_Unapologetic Republicans_**.

Let me be very, very clear...these are the Values that make up the Republican Party. When someone says they are Republican then, this is the document with which we can hold each other accountable to. _**This is the document that all State GOP's should have a condensed version of. This is the document that all County GOP's should have even more refined to the local context.**_ No other person, or governing entity, or lobbyist, or donor, or elected official defines the Platform document. The collective delegates at the 2024 Convention in Milwaukee will determine if there are any changes needed or if we should adhere to it as is.

We must do this or the America we grew up in will be forever lost. There is a concerted attempt by the Biden Administration and the powers that be to destroy Nationalism. If a people no longer have a sense of pride in the Nation, then what is there to fight for? There is a purposeful supplanting by VOLUME through open borders to tip the balance. If the ideals of America mean nothing to the NEW majority, because this is not their home they created, then a culture destabilizes. This creates a level of chaos and fear in the average, unassuming American who just wants everything and everyone to be nice. Once there is chaos, a controlling government OWNED by an elite class can "require" aggression to return to stability. Those that are in control will be able to choose whom and where the aggression is deployed to and create new laws and weaponization of FBI, CIA, etc.

We remember that the [NEGOP Constitution](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=4565f46805&e=25844e23a8) lays out that membership is Republicans _who desire to support the objectives of the Party_. The **objectives of our Party is the maintenance the government of, by, and for the people and to further our principles** (within the communities). I have found that our greatest challenge in finding __**stability**__ as a party is understanding and communicating our [principle](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=f34d5f9ecd&e=25844e23a8)[s](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=a04018269b&e=25844e23a8). Our second challenge is seeing the necessity to increase _**healthy conversations**_ around the implementation of the principles and NOT which one is of greatest priority. We RARELY examine, discuss, communicate and promote the EXACT values of the party. What EXACTLY is the WRITTEN and DOCUMENTED Platform Value that we disagree on?

This is where the people of the Party have to make their stand. If we (and I mean ALL, when I say WE) don't have a collective conversation about our principles, articulate them passionately but with a common sense context, then our opposition will control that narrative. **It's time to be an unapologetic REPUBLICAN!** It's time to be an educated and proactive _[Constitutional](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=a73b59bea3&e=25844e23a8) and [Platform](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=dbe3df64b5&e=25844e23a8) Republican_ (CPR). As a CPR, you will breathe life into our message and the voters will believe again in the party as a WHOLE.
I envision a bridge to bring stability within our party...with our [Constitution](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=aa9a61c8a6&e=25844e23a8) as the framework, our [Platform Values](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=ce8f50808c&e=25844e23a8) as the planks on which we stand, and the stability is grounded in a firm foundation of our Faith in the Word. I am amazingly blessed by those who already stand on this bridge and even more so...the Party, the membership of this Party...the People, are blessed by the talents of so many like-minded servant leaders who volunteer their time.

For fast reading here are some key components of our Republican Party Platform.
Taxation - Page 1.
2nd Amendment - Page 12.
Protecting Human Life - Page 13 - 14.
Election Integrity - Page 16.
Energy - Page 19.
Balanced Federal Budget - Page 23. (Interestingly predicted a $30 Trillion deficit by 2026)
Families & Marriage - Page 31.
Education - Page 33.
Defense - Page 41, 46-48. (Interestingly, details an emboldened China, a resurgent Russia occupying parts of Ukraine, and an aggressive Islamist terror network in the Middle East. Can't say we didn't see this coming...2016!)

I would appreciate your time to submit your opinions to this survey. This is an in-house survey, on a submission page from the app Anedot. Your information is kept in-house, but the main survey questions results could make a difference in future Party decisions. Thank you for your time to fill this out.
[https://secure.anedot.com/negop/presidential-debate-poll](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=4e5ba3f20e&e=25844e23a8) [](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=81f51dc22d&e=25844e23a8) The truth shall set us free.

With much blessings,
---
|
---
| –Chairman Underwood

Dear Friend,
I proud to announce that our campaign has been endorsed by NOW PAC, the political action committee of the National Organization for Women!
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
This endorsement is personally important to me because I have been an active member of NOW, working with the organization here in PA to advance our shared goals. The core issues of NOW reflect my values, and the values of all of us who want to live in a country that is fairer and more just.
As an attorney, a member of City Council, and a candidate for Congress I have spent my career fighting for the same things that NOW and its members fight for every day:
*
Reproductive
Rights
and
Justice
*
Economic
Justice
*
Ending
Violence
Against
Women
*
Racial
Justice
*
LGBTQIA+
Rights
*
Constitutional
Equality
If you would like to learn more about NOW and how its members fight for these issues, I encourage you to learn more about NOW by clicking here. [https://now.org/issues/]
I believe that you share NOW's priorities too. If we want to see these priorities reflected in our public policy, we need to elect leaders who also share those priorities. You know me, and you know that I will fight for these priorities in Congress because I am already fighting for them, and have been for a long time.
I am grateful to the members of NOW who have placed their trust in me and my campaign, and I hope that you will join them by supporting my campaign!
Shamaine

subject: Humbly asking for your support this Giving Tuesday

body:
When you think of an organization you’d like to give to today, I hope you’ll consider choosing GIFFORDS PAC
#

Today is Giving Tuesday, the day Americans across the country give back by making donations to support causes they believe are making a difference.
**I know there are many worthy causes out there. But when you think of an organization you’d like to give to today, I hope you’ll consider choosing GIFFORDS PAC to support us in our ongoing efforts to end gun violence:**
**[DONATE TODAY](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-nov23.H_pglF&refcode=em231128-1-30&t=1&akid=6957%2E3935704%2Ev1h21s)**
While a lot of people might think it was my own shooting that inspired me to commit my life’s work to ending gun violence, that wasn’t the case. The shooting at Sandy Hook Elementary School in Newtown, Connecticut was the reason I decided to devote myself to this fight.
Even though I was in the midst of my own recovery, I knew I couldn’t just sit back. We had to do more than just talk. So my husband Mark and I founded GIFFORDS—known at the time as Americans for Responsible Solutions.
I am immensely proud of how much we have achieved together in the last ten years. Our movement to protect communities from gun violence has made a difference nationwide. But we still have a lot more to do to finish this fight. People are still dying from gun violence each and every day.
[**In honor of Giving Tuesday, I’m humbly asking you to make a contribution to GIFFORDS PAC. Your support is the only way we can continue our work to save lives.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-nov23.H_pglF&refcode=em231128-1-30&t=2&akid=6957%2E3935704%2Ev1h21s)
