body:
It's Official! | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/e8a6e409c2ee/conforti-for-congress-8391168?e=25f4fa3311)
---
| | |
---
| | | Dear Peter,

Yesterday was the first day to file nominating petitions for Illinois candidates in the 2024 elections. For me, it was an early morning drive to Springfield, watching the sunrise along the way.

Once there, I stood in the cold for 2 hours to be one of the first to file my petitions. With the help of many supporters, I was able to file more than 3x what was needed - nearly 2,000 signatures, to get on the ballot for next year's election for U.S. Congressional District 6.

The Primary election is March 19th, with early voting starting in February.

Be sure to cast your vote! We need all Republicans voting in the next election to overtake the Democrats and turn District 6 Red Again!

The race won't be cheap. In order to best compete - and win, I am asking for your financial support. Please consider making a contribution to my campaign to help me get to Congress and defend our rights. No amount is too small.

[](https://conforti4congress.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7fd34b7284bf7f5e87a4e45e5&id=6288e55134&e=25f4fa3311)

Your support is greatly appreciated.
Stay strong!
---
| Thank you,

Niki Conforti
Candidate
Illinois 6th Congressional District

Peter, The Texas Supreme Court hearing of the case challenging the state’s near-total abortion ban is underway. The case represents a group of twenty women suing the state of Texas — women who were denied access to necessary abortion care after severe and life-threatening pregnancy complications. One woman couldn’t receive an abortion in her home state, even though her pregnancy was unlikely to make it full-term, and even if it did, the baby would not survive after birth. It is a gruesome and traumatic story, but one that Texas’ extreme abortion ban makes all too common. We’re watching the hearing closely today, and in order to prepare for all possible scenarios, we’re building up an action fund to fight back. Whatever the result, we’ll be working hard to restore reproductive rights in Texas and around the country. This is important. It really matters. And that’s why we need your help.
Out of all the people who receive these emails less than 5% donate.

Dear Friend,

Charles Dickens, a very great novelist, had a special gift for revealing important truths in delightful ways through unforgettable characters.

To mark this holiday season, Hillsdale College is releasing a new online course on what is perhaps Dickens' most beloved novel: _A Christmas Carol_.

The course is taught by the excellent Dwight Lindley, an English professor here at Hillsdale who loves both reading Dickens and teaching Dickens.

In this six-lecture course, Dwight will help you understand more fully the causes of Ebenezer Scrooge's conversion in the novel and what the story teaches us about leading a happy and complete life.

You can use the secure link below to begin experiencing the wisdom and fun of _A Christmas Carol_ today.

**[https://online.hillsdale.edu/prereg/christmas-carol](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z0tk1r8b7shk6qpae1hcuqs67l1pht2bm6eboil0_rp22sh2s8i6eo34c9g6cob0c3h2bs)**

Let your family and friends know of this free online course as well. We hope it will add meaning and joy to your Christmas celebrations.

Best regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: I want your opinion on religious liberty
body:
American Cornerstone Institute
We need your voice.

|
---
| | | [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zcmdk7stfc0iee7v9o6hp9pk1poehjvts6lni51g_rp22sh2s8i6eo34c9g62pj4c3h2bs)
---
| Dear Fellow American,

I am reaching out today because I believe that you, like me, are concerned about the increasing trend of legal persecution against Americans who wish to live their lives according to their faith. Our cornerstones of faith, liberty, community, and life form the bedrock of our great nation, and we need your help to maintain them. [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zd5405s4ommhk99l68bla0nschfs1dertsar80tg_rp22sh2s8i6eo34c9g62pj4c3h2bs) From a high school football coach in Washington who lost his job for praying on the field (KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT), to a Colorado baker hauled through the legal system multiple times for not wanting to bake a cake that violated his religious convictions (MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION), we can't ignore the gradual erosion of religious freedom in America.

That's why I created the American Cornerstone Institute to advocate for commonsense solutions to these issues and to strengthen the bonds that keep our nation united. But we can't do it alone.

**We need your voice.**

I want to personally invite you to participate in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**You can share your thoughts using this secure link:[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zarrqh1r43h3tedi5ai8gv00lmlngndm7rf2sn18_rp22sh2s8i6eo34c9g62pj4c3h2bs)**

Your responses are confidential and will be used solely towards furthering our advocacy efforts.

[Please, take a few minutes of your time to complete the survey.](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zh4h6n6csj509t31up80u6tt5sdkhkn661rn1keg_rp22sh2s8i6eo34c9g62pj4c3h2bs) Your input is vital in helping us understand the scope of these issues and develop impactful strategies to counteract them.

Your opinion truly matters. Together, we can ensure that religious liberty continues to thrive as an integral part of our American society.

For Liberty,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder and Chairman
American Cornerstone Institute

---
Your donation to ACI helps us to focus on our mission of promoting and preserving individual and religious liberty, helping our country’s most vulnerable find new hope, and developing methods to decrease the federal government’s role in society and to improve efficiency to best serve ALL our nation’s citizens.

The Southern Resident orca population is at one of its lowest points in decades. These magnificent creatures are on the **BRINK OF EXTINCTION.**
**First:** New orca mother Tahlequah mourned her baby when it died just thirty minutes after being born. She carried her calf's body over 1,000 miles in her grief before letting go.
**Then:** Playful Cappuccino, Marina the matriarch, and young Ripple died from starvation. Their families are still grieving their deaths.
**Now:** Two new orcas were just born._** But they are already in extreme danger of starving to death. **_
I wish I could be nothing but excited about these new orca births. But I'm worried -- and I thought you might be too. That’s because **the mortality rate for newborn orcas is as high as 50%!** You see, the remaining 75 Southern Resident orcas are facing a chronic lack of food. They’re in danger of starving to death. This is so serious that these gentle giants have been deemed “vulnerable” due to their astonishingly poor physical condition.
But it gets worse, Friend. A new shipping terminal and oil pipeline expansion threaten the remaining whales, their entire ecosystems, and the communities who live nearby. Just one oil spill could completely wipe out the last remaining orcas -- including these new babies.
[](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2153679?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
We need your help if these majestic orcas and their beautiful ocean habitats are going to stand a chance against Big Polluters. At Friends of the Earth, we are working to get more oil spill protections in place in the Pacific Northwest along with efforts to reduce shipping noise, and oppose these pipeline and shipping terminal projects. But we can't win this fight without your help.
**Every dollar you give before midnight tonight will be MATCHED to meet our $200,000 Giving Tuesday goal and continue our critical work. Rush a membership donation now and have it go TWICE AS FAR to protect Southern Resident orcas, other endangered animals, and our planet! **

#
Powerful interests -- fossil fuel giants, Big Pharma, billionaire CEOs, you name it -- have a very handy tool at their disposal: piles and piles of money.
They use their money to fund campaigns for politicians who ask “How high?” when they say “Jump.” They use their money to hire armies of lobbyists that swarm Capitol Hill. They use their money to put government on their side, all so they can make even bigger piles of money.
But we’ve got a powerful tool on our side too: a grassroots movement. And we’re delivering results.
Side by side, we took back the House. We flipped the White House. We won the Senate. And we used that power to beat those powerful interests and make real change for working people, including:
* The biggest-ever American investment in fighting climate change, which will help reduce carbon emissions by 40% by 2030.
* The first-ever authorization for Medicare to negotiate lower prescription drug prices -- and a guaranteed $35 cap on monthly insulin costs for people on Medicare.
* A 15% minimum corporate tax — so billionaire corporations can’t get away with reporting billions in profits and paying nothing in taxes.
* Getting student debt canceled for millions of borrowers -- despite the Supreme Court substituting politics for the rule of law and striking down President Biden’s broader plan.

Democrats win when we go out there and unapologetically fight for the big, structural change we need — to stand up to powerful special interests and advocate for real change for working people. I’m going to continue fighting for this.
**Grassroots supporters like you make it possible to defeat the powerful interests and put power in the hands of working people, where it belongs. But we’ve got a big fight ahead of us in 2024, and if the GOP gains any more power, they’ll work to pass their extremist agenda and actively reverse all the progress we’ve made together.**
[**Can you split a donation of $5 or whatever makes sense right now between our campaign and The Long Run to keep up the fight for our plans that will put more power in the hands of working people? Together, we can keep building a government that works for everyone, not just the rich and powerful.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-warren-split.-45zWj&refcode=em231128-1-tt&t=1&akid=5031%2E196590%2E9LY0iS)
Thanks for being a part of this,
Elizabeth

We'd hate to see you go, but if you'd like you can [**unsubscribe here**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe?t=2&akid=5031%2E196590%2E9LY0iS). You can also [**sign up to receive fewer emails.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/signup/fewer-emails/?source=em-footer&t=3&akid=5031%2E196590%2E9LY0iS)

Brace yourself, friend, this is serious. Last year, almost **ONE-SIXTH of Florida’s manatee population was DECIMATED by starvation and pollution. 2023 is on track to be another deadly year for these gentle creatures, with over 400 manatees having already perished since January. **
**Mega-polluting industries like Big Cruise fuel this tragedy with reckless dumping and massive quantities of CO2 emissions.** Cruise ships are STILL allowed to dump filthy, contaminated wastewater – including toxic, acidic wastewater – directly into ocean habitats that are critical for vulnerable species! This harmful pollution feeds destructive algae blooms that kill manatees' primary food source, seagrass. No wonder manatee deaths are spiking from painful starvation!
**But it gets worse. **Cruise ships never stop running, even when they dock – and they’re powered by some of the dirtiest heavy fuel. **Every day, a mid-sized cruise ship emits as much particulate pollution as ONE MILLION CARS.** Coastal communities are trapped, breathing in this harmful pollution and suffering higher rates of respiratory diseases as a result.
**We MUST hold cruise companies and other Big Polluters accountable for the damage they cause. clean_body: | | | | | ---|---|--- | | | BEFORE GIVING TUESDAY ENDS: YOUR MATCHED GIFT IS NEEDED TO PROTECT OUR OCEANS, COMMUNITIES AND EARTH | | == Brace yourself, friend, this is serious. Last year, almost ONE-SIXTH of Florida’s manatee population was DECIMATED by starvation and pollution. 2023 is on track to be another deadly year for these gentle creatures, with over 400 manatees having already perished since January. Mega-polluting industries like Big Cruise fuel this tragedy with reckless dumping and massive quantities of CO2 emissions. Cruise ships are STILL allowed to dump filthy, contaminated wastewater – including toxic, acidic wastewater – directly into ocean habitats that are critical for vulnerable species! This harmful pollution feeds destructive algae blooms that kill manatees' primary food source, seagrass. No wonder manatee deaths are spiking from painful starvation! But it gets worse. Cruise ships never stop running, even when they dock – and they’re powered by some of the dirtiest heavy fuel. Every day, a mid-sized cruise ship emits as much particulate pollution as ONE MILLION CARS. Coastal communities are trapped, breathing in this harmful pollution and suffering higher rates of respiratory diseases as a result. We MUST hold cruise companies and other Big Polluters accountable for the damage they cause. That’s why Friends of the Earth urgently needs your support before Giving Tuesday ends. That's because right now, a generous group of donors is MATCHING every gift up to $200,000 – and we’re counting on supporters like you to make the most of this match before it expires at midnight TONIGHT. == == With pandemic travel restrictions lifted, the cruise industry is BOOMING. That means more ships – the size of city blocks – speeding through coastal waters and spewing their endless pollution. The industry has grown so fast that governments have struggled to regulate it. Greedy cruise companies have taken advantage of this situation, going beyond the huge quantities of LEGAL pollution to illegal dumping. Worse, some companies have SUED to block coastal communities from exercising their rights and protecting themselves from emissions-induced diseases! No company should be able to take away our right to fight for our health and the health of our neighbors. For the sake of our oceans, our people and our planet, we MUST fight back. Friends of the Earth is standing up against the greedy cruise industry that prioritizes profits over human lives, helpless wildlife and the health of our planet. We are working to make sure proper regulations exist and are enforced for massive cruise ships.Reaching our Giving Tuesday goal is critical to continuing this planet-saving work, and stopping ocean-wrecking, climate-destroying pollution from entering our ecosystems. But we rely on support from people like you, who understand how high the stakes are right now. ---

| | Did you catch this message from Rick last week? Here's the latest in the rural health care space:
1. **Substance Abuse Prevention and Treatment:** Rural residents are more likely to be prescribed opioids for pain and less likely to have access to specialized substance abuse treatment and medications that treat opioid use disorder due to a shortage of options compared to their more urban counterparts. Fortunately, $990,557 has been awarded to Whidbey Island to ensure residents have equitable access to medication, counseling, and behavioral therapy services.
2. **Serving Veterans:** Rick reintroduced legislation that would make it easier and safer for veterans to keep their medical appointments and access quality health care, regardless of their zip codes.
3. **Reducing Shortages:** Rick supported legislation that would expand affordable housing and child care, and is working to increase funding to train health professionals and address nursing education, practice, retention and recruitment.
4. **Increasing Capacity:** Three rural access hospitals in our district provide 24/7 emergency care services, and the region's long-term inpatient psychiatric facilities for youth have very limited capacity — Rick is supporting legislation to make meaningful investments in pediatric mental health care and increase capacity at hospitals.
5. **Reproductive Health Care:** Right now, there isn't a single in-person abortion service provider in Island County. Rick's protecting a doctor's ability to prescribe medication abortion via telehealth to ensure patients in rural communities have options. It's not just about abortion care — Rick supported additional funding for STI clinics to respond to a rise in monkeypox.

**Rick knows what it takes to get things accomplished for underserved communities in Northwest Washington and beyond, and it's critical that we have his advocacy in the House.**[**Will you make a contribution today to help re-elect Rick?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/74137979/440729831/1596212816?refcode=2023-11-28-rural&recurring=&amount=5&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=53691c0e-0d8e-ee11-8924-6045bdd47111&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MzY5MWMwZS0wZDhlLWVlMTEtODkyNC02MDQ1YmRkNDcxMTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3gCXZdJEl9GwGsxocYmsJ1oQdrE2cl0fqFe7arF2HzE=) _Team Rick_ | Express Donate: If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:

From: Rick Larsen [campaign@ricklarsen.org]
Date: Mon, Mov 20, 2023 at 11:22 AM
Subject: Improving health policies in rural WA-02
To: dpwillis67@gmail.com
**Ensuring access to high quality, affordable health care is essential for everyone, but especially challenging for folks who live in rural Northwest Washington communities.**
In Washington, our rural hospitals serve upwards of 70% of the geographic area and 15% of our population. What sets rural hospitals apart from their counterparts in more densely populated areas? They create critical connections for local health care services and a bridge to specialized care outside the community at bigger medical facilities.
**My goal is to better understand and address the unique challenges rural communities face in delivering health care to enable all people to live healthy lives, so that is why I have joined a bipartisan Congressional Caucus on rural health.**
Here is what I will be working on with the caucus:
* Improving access to specialized substance abuse prevention and treatment
* Breaking down barriers for military families and veterans
* Increasing the number of beds for long-term care and pediatric behavioral health
* Addressing workforce shortages
* Improving access to reproductive health care

Of course, I will continue to champion federal investments in resources and innovative solutions to lower drug prices and improve health care access and outcomes in rural communities.
[**I am excited to get to work with the caucus to improve health outcomes for**** _every_****zip code. If you would like to support this effort, consider chipping in to my re-election campaign.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/74137984/440729836/1596212816?refcode=2023-11-28-rural&recurring=&amount=5&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=53691c0e-0d8e-ee11-8924-6045bdd47111&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MzY5MWMwZS0wZDhlLWVlMTEtODkyNC02MDQ1YmRkNDcxMTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3gCXZdJEl9GwGsxocYmsJ1oQdrE2cl0fqFe7arF2HzE=)

clean_body: Breaking Down Barriers to Rural Health Care | | | | Did you catch this message from Rick last week? Here's the latest in the rural health care space: 1. Substance Abuse Prevention and Treatment: Rural residents are more likely to be prescribed opioids for pain and less likely to have access to specialized substance abuse treatment and medications that treat opioid use disorder due to a shortage of options compared to their more urban counterparts. Fortunately, $990,557 has been awarded to Whidbey Island to ensure residents have equitable access to medication, counseling, and behavioral therapy services. 2. Serving Veterans: Rick reintroduced legislation that would make it easier and safer for veterans to keep their medical appointments and access quality health care, regardless of their zip codes. 3. Reducing Shortages: Rick supported legislation that would expand affordable housing and child care, and is working to increase funding to train health professionals and address nursing education, practice, retention and recruitment. 4. Increasing Capacity: Three rural access hospitals in our district provide 24/7 emergency care services, and the region's long-term inpatient psychiatric facilities for youth have very limited capacity — Rick is supporting legislation to make meaningful investments in pediatric mental health care and increase capacity at hospitals. 5. Reproductive Health Care: Right now, there isn't a single in-person abortion service provider in Island County. Rick's protecting a doctor's ability to prescribe medication abortion via telehealth to ensure patients in rural communities have options. It's not just about abortion care — Rick supported additional funding for STI clinics to respond to a rise in monkeypox. Rick knows what it takes to get things accomplished for underserved communities in Northwest Washington and beyond, and it's critical that we have his advocacy in the House.= Team Rick | Express Donate: If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: | = | = | = | = ---|---|---|--- \---------- Forwarded message --------- From: Rick Larsen [campaign@ricklarsen.org] Date: Mon, Mov 20, 2023 at 11:22 AM Subject: Improving health policies in rural WA-02 To: dpwillis67@gmail.com Ensuring access to high quality, affordable health care is essential for everyone, but especially challenging for folks who live in rural Northwest Washington communities. In Washington, our rural hospitals serve upwards of 70% of the geographic area and 15% of our population. What sets rural hospitals apart from their counterparts in more densely populated areas? They create critical connections for local health care services and a bridge to specialized care outside the community at bigger medical facilities. My goal is to better understand and address the unique challenges rural communities face in delivering health care to enable all people to live healthy lives, so that is why I have joined a bipartisan Congressional Caucus on rural health. Here is what I will be working on with the caucus: Improving access to specialized substance abuse prevention and treatment Breaking down barriers for military families and veterans Increasing the number of beds for long-term care and pediatric behavioral health Addressing workforce shortages Improving access to reproductive health care Of course, I will continue to champion federal investments in resources and innovative solutions to lower drug prices and improve health care access and outcomes in rural communities. = Rick Express Donate: If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: | = | = | = | = ---|---|---|--- | | Paid for and authorized by Citizens to Elect Rick Larsen. | This email was sent by .** Citizens to Elect Rick Larsen PO Box 326 Everett, WA 98206 United States Email is an important way for Rick Larsen to keep supporters like you informed about critical issues and to build a winning grassroots campaign. Dear fellow Patriot, Thanks so much for your support of my campaign for the United States Senate race in Virginia. Over the past 8 months, we’ve made tremendous progress building a campaign organization that can win in 2024. Earlier this month, Virginia held elections for State Senate, House of Delegates, and local offices. Within hours of the polls closing, there was an incredibly misleading narrative that Republicans lost and lost BIG. **It was FAKE NEWS.** The truth is that Republicans picked up one State Senate seat, and narrowly lost the House of Delegates. Republicans won important local races all throughout Virginia, including a victory over Buta Biberaj – the radical Soros Prosecutor from Loudoun County. The rush by the legacy media to decrease Governor Youngkin’s national political standing was irresponsible. If just 2,000 votes moved the other direction, the story would have been about a Youngkin “Trifecta”. So what should the takeaway from the Virginia elections be? **VIRGINIA IS COMPETITIVE AND IS A SWING-STATE IN 2024.** Thanks to the hard work of Governor Youngkin, the Republican Party of Virginia, the Spirit of Virginia, and high-quality candidates, we know the blueprint for firing Tim Kaine in 2024. This month, I've enjoyed traveling throughout the Commonwealth, meeting hundreds of Virginians that are ready to vote to make a change and save our country. On Monday night, I spoke at a packed Loudon County GOP meeting.
---
---
I also enjoyed meeting with the DC Young Republicans, most of which live in Virginia.
---
---
And on Friday, Cortlynn and Natalynn joined me in Arlington for "Coffee and Cannoli with Cortlynn." The event packed the restaurant - on Black Friday! - and we enjoyed sharing our story.
---

name: Giving Tuesday@LCV
subject: We really can't afford to come up short this Giving Tuesday. Please, please, please open:
body:
__The ONLY way we 'll hit this goal is with your help. |
---

|
Peter -- earlier this month, we got the incredible news that a major donor put up a $100,000 challenge grant to fund LCV's pro-environment campaigns into the new year.

The catch is that this grant ONLY unlocks if 1,000 LCV members make a contribution before midnight on Giving Tuesday -- **that 's tonight, just a few hours away. And right now, we're not on track to meet this goal.**

[We really can't afford to come up short on this one. Please, please, please renew your LCV membership and help unlock an additional $100,000 to fund our critical campaigns >>](https://links.messages.lcv.)

_REMEMBER: If you start a monthly donation -- even if it's just $5 -- we get to count it 12 times!_

| | **
** **FOR IMMEDIATE REVIEW**

**Supporter Record:** Peter Willis
**Email:** dpwillis67@gmail.com

**GOAL:** 1,000 donations by midnight tomorrow
**PROGRESS:** 24% to goal

**STATUS:** [Renew now -- it only takes $5 >>](https://links.messages.lcv.) |
---|---|---

Peter, we honestly can't afford to leave this kind of money on the table -- not when our movement is up against so much, and the stakes are so high for people and our planet. Here's a little more info why hitting this goal matters SO much:
1. **Because Republicans are _still_ threatening to shut down our government unless they get massive cuts to environmental programs.** We just narrowly avoided a government shutdown, but the next funding deadline is right around the corner, and every environmental legislative attack the MAGA fringe has passed in recent weeks is still on the table: We _have_ to make sure all of our progress doesn't end up on the chopping block now. [We're counting on your support to defend the environment in Congress. Pitch in now >>](https://links.messages.lcv.)
2. **Because we can get closer to our goal of protecting 30 percent of U.S. lands and waters by 2030 with more monument designations.** President Biden has already taken action to protect cultural and sacred sites for Indigenous people and landscapes rich in ecological and historical value in Nevada and Arizona, accessible plateaus and ridges in Texas, landmarks honoring the fight for racial justice and snow-capped peaks in Colorado, among others. Now there are even more opportunities to protect more lands and culturally significant sites for people rather than for logging and fossil fuel industries -- and we need people like you on our side. [We can win these fights, but only if the environmental movement shows up >>](https://links.messages.lcv.)
3. **Because we have the chance to shut down the Dakota Access Oil Pipeline once and for all.** For years, the Standing Rock Sioux Tribe has led the fight against the dirty Pipeline, which threatens clean drinking water for millions of people. Now, the Army Corps of Engineers has been ordered by the courts to conduct a new environmental impact analysis and take public comment as a result of the Tribe's steadfast opposition. [This is our best-ever opportunity to shut down this project -- and your support can help make that happen. Donate today >>](https://links.messages.lcv.)
4. **Because a group of donors has offered $100,000 in matching gift funds.** Bottom line: Your contribution goes further to win environmental campaigns that matter if you give now and help unlock this critical funding. [Renew your LCV membership for $5 today >>](https://links.messages.lcv.)

**Peter -- if we can get 1,000 donations before midnight tonight and unlock the $100,000 challenge grant, it'll be a gamechanger for each and every one of these campaigns.**

[The ONLY way we'll get there is with your help -- I really hope you'll renew your membership today. Remember: Even gifts of $5 count!](https://links.messages.lcv.)

Thank you for your support of LCV's work!

Onward,

Gene Karpinski
President
League of Conservation Voters
__
__

name: Bob
subject: A word on the shoreline
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY THE FRIENDS OF DR
body:
We must have hope and trust even when it hurts.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP12/1/92793/images/TOP.png]
We're told so much is wrong with our country that we cannot even work with 'the other side', but throughout all the turmoil, division, and vitriol in politics, I still hold hope; hope that we can come together to address America's pressing problems.
We just need better leaders. [actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP12/1/92793/images/Export.png]
If honored to serve as a Representative in Congress, I intend to bring reason, dignity and integrity back to this seat, but I need your help getting to DC.
Can you keep our people-powered grassroots campaign strong going into December?
[https://gen.sendtric.com/countdown/e1k4zbgmh0]
CONTRIBUTE BEFORE DEC. 1 [actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
Friend,
Legislators don't always have to agree, but they must work together to find reasonable solutions to common problems.
Hope in politics may feel as fleeting as a word painted on the shoreline, but if its meaning is embedded in us, we can carry it every day.
This is why I'm running for Congress. I will continue to hold the faith that our better days are in front of us.
As a family doctor, I know that healthy citizens are essential to achieving our goals. That's why I am committed to fighting for Medicare For All and lower prescription drug prices.
Additionally, we need leaders that support small businesses, workers, and the middle class; the engines of our economy.
We must also advocate for lifelong learning and education, as the future of our success depends on it.
Our shoreline will tell you - Climate change is real , and we must take action to preserve our environment and transition to clean, green energy in a sustainable way. This will create good-paying jobs that help us transition while remaining energy-independent.
Most importantly, we must support our democracy, protect voters' rights, and advocate for women's rights.
With kindness, honesty, integrity, and the wisdom we Americans possess, we must maintain the hope that, together, we absolutely can achieve a better day.
This is why I need your support.
Thank you,
-Dr. Bob
Bob Lorinser
Candidate for US Congress
Northern Michigan / Upper Peninsula
Democrat, MI01

| Whether you're saving for retirement, considering major purchases, planning your estate, or just want a second set of eyes on your investments, hiring a financial advisor who you feel best suits your needs could be key. A 2022 Northwestern Mutual study found that 62% of U.S. adults admit their financial planning needs improvement. However, only 35% of Americans work with a financial advisor.1 The value of working with a financial advisor varies by person. While advisors are legally prohibited from promising returns, research suggests that people who [work with a financial advisor](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3b8b43d97eea46799236d43039b6de1d&_e=qticvtxD2Im3sPKTFKqRNBovrWGvQZTk1yk8L-MK5z-sCyGFNOWlFyPPTEkrDdog0t37LsAg-0e3UgevgkgcIQgSED1ZxbSajSFPmB9q4VyJFhB_rOuGGAmiB7JJeiHbvU8P6sRZ-EHzoexwvWJebcQfhoYD9Ap_6Dz9WCa2xZ_O59yrlEJC8EGz6fnIsmB8Ay2uM7f_QYFmgc2HbDuzakw4tr78yePLz-Ol2TJotiZ5Z8N_jwHGoMCnZEhFQItbcoK9I5f8nHo7nnoxW3KzoS7ENzR6k_P_dI3o4FWMI0UPrDJskiaCAHi48VAlqbWkJ4IkRlsqTBYscWCOf264ZBQmapBf9luSh0T8CdE97Mc1G1ip9QfveFTxQj0AfTz--9kbCnqMcG_bJ0zBXRLUvk-vB2Lbpi-JmDoWOpxNYwNezhWkG5D2hk7pEump93w4KrXfdqu3YKRqrKwJVWu3RA%3D%3D) feel more at ease about their finances and could potentially end up with about 15% more money to spend in retirement.2 Whatever your reasons for seeking financial advice, it's important to have a list of questions planned to ensure you're hiring a financial advisor who can help you plan to reach your goals.
### **5 Questions to Ask When Choosing a Financial Advisor**
**1\. Are You a Fiduciary?** Fiduciaries are financial advisors with a legal obligation to prioritize your interests as they manage your assets or money. Unlike a broker who may push you into insurance policies or investments to rack up fees and commissions, fiduciaries are bound to recommend options that benefit you, the customer. While conflicts of interest can still exist, any potential conflicts of interest must be disclosed. SmartAsset's [free tool](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3b8b43d97eea46799236d43039b6de1d&_e=qticvtxD2Im3sPKTFKqRNBovrWGvQZTk1yk8L-MK5z-sCyGFNOWlFyPPTEkrDdog0t37LsAg-0e3UgevgkgcIQgSED1ZxbSajSFPmB9q4VyJFhB_rOuGGAmiB7JJeiHbvU8P6sRZ-EHzoexwvWJebcQfhoYD9Ap_6Dz9WCa2xZ_O59yrlEJC8EGz6fnIsmB8Ay2uM7f_QYFmgc2HbDuzakw4tr78yePLz-Ol2TJotiZ5Z8N_jwHGoMCnZEhFQItbcoK9I5f8nHo7nnoxW3KzoS7ENzR6k_P_dI3o4FWMI0W--siYfecd8OUeaIvzeUXlkuHqEKCKAlWhB5Xf-Hht-w15GPxrdvJSj_f9hKP2W5lr2yl5aZOdhRGQOWcfQ6AVDpNgU907lo5-HrSqcfsBZf76KPuSD4V9Ad95xSg3jojOnn-QGdPJzmHo6RAZ-yUbgsODLvD6MeTyhPHSu4kRmg%3D%3D) will only match you with vetted fiduciary advisors. **2\. How Much Experience Do You Have?** In addition to asking about their professional certification, it can also be a good idea to ask a prospective financial advisor about their overall experience. Generally, the more experience they have the better, especially if your financial situation is complicated. You should consider asking about their education, previous employers and track record of success. You might also want to consider performing a background check to find out whether they've ever been convicted of a crime or been involved in a criminal investigation by a regulatory or trade group. Don't be afraid to ask for references from current or previous clients, and be wary of a financial advisor who seems reluctant to provide this information. **3\. What Type of Services Do You Offer?** Some financial advisors offer a range of services, while others specialize in niche aspects of financial management. For example, some advisors may only handle investments, while others take a more comprehensive approach, including retirement, estate planning and tax planning, along with other services. Ideally, you should look for an advisor whose range of services most closely fit your current and future needs. It's also helpful to ask whether they specialize in a specific type of client. Some financial advisors may cater to retirees while others may prefer to work with families or divorcees. Some advisors cater to high-net-worth clients. [Choosing an advisor](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3b8b43d97eea46799236d43039b6de1d&_e=qticvtxD2Im3sPKTFKqRNBovrWGvQZTk1yk8L-MK5z-sCyGFNOWlFyPPTEkrDdog0t37LsAg-0e3UgevgkgcIQgSED1ZxbSajSFPmB9q4VyJFhB_rOuGGAmiB7JJeiHbvU8P6sRZ-EHzoexwvWJebcQfhoYD9Ap_6Dz9WCa2xZ_O59yrlEJC8EGz6fnIsmB8Ay2uM7f_QYFmgc2HbDuzakw4tr78yePLz-Ol2TJotiZ5Z8N_jwHGoMCnZEhFQItbcoK9I5f8nHo7nnoxW3KzoS7ENzR6k_P_dI3o4FWMI0WP23nuqHoXRnhNgg5i2jcGrIXo_6Lyf05c8OWzG-FRjHQ25b4-6CDc2gFxaQwFy3IWGPF3atW5IbQ1k0u2xO9UlIVDc-zNOyffSoqZ98fkwUcPScgtn2SeOZ3OgmhDwPwbRugXGCOQ3wIQqjQJz5gVh9ruOGmxwZiH9w0HCRUjmg%3D%3D) who works exclusively with clients whose situations are similar to yours means they could be better equipped to offer the type of guidance and advice you may be seeking. **4\. What 's Your Fee Structure?** Before you sign on the dotted line, you need to know how much your prospective financial planner will charge for their services. Depending on the type of professional you're working with, they may receive a flat or hourly fee, be paid on commissions, or a combination of both. Fee-based advisers, for example, charge an up-front fee, but may also get a commission for selling financial products. Fee-only advisors make money from the fees they charge their clients. Some fee-only advisors charge a flat rate while others charge by the hour. Advisors who cater to high-net-worth clients may calculate their fees based on a percentage of the assets under management. **5\. What 's Your Investment Approach?** You should also consider asking prospective advisors about their investing approach. If you're not comfortable taking on a lot of risk, you could consider a financial advisor who advocates a more conservative strategy. Knowing whether or not their investment style matches your personal investing philosophy beforehand could potentially save you complications in the long run.
## **How to Find a Vetted Fiduciary Financial Advisor**
This is the biggest hurdle for many. With thousands of daily Google searches for "Fiduciary financial advisors near me," "best fiduciary financial advisor," and "financial investment advisors near me," the hunt for a vetted fiduciary advisor can feel like a wild goose chase. body:
It’s a damn shame we can’t do that in the U.S. Senate
#
Peter — in the Marines, knowingly undermining our national security would get you court-martialed and thrown in the brig.
It’s a damn shame we can’t do that in the U.S. Senate.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/39400?refcode=em20231128-4276&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=4276%2E614464%2EdDGtGj)
Three months ago, I published an op-ed in Fox News explaining why Senator Tommy Tuberville’s already months-long blockade of military confirmations was a serious threat to our country’s national security. Not much has changed since then.
**Tuberville, and other Senators like Josh Hawley, have continued to sabotage our military because they think their personal politics are more important.**
It’s not just wrong — it’s stupid. So before I ask you to chip in toward my campaign to replace Josh Hawley, please let me share my perspective as a 13-year Marine veteran about the real impact this blockade has on service members, military families, and our national security:

It’s the one thing they thought they had control over, now frozen in place.
People aren’t getting the promotion they worked so hard for. Their families are facing uncertainty about where they’ll work or send their kids to school.
It’s just another example of our politicians using service members for political leverage. The same way they recently used us veterans for political leverage by holding up the PACT Act — which takes care of us for burn pit exposure we received in Iraq and Afghanistan.

Senator Tuberville is quite literally punishing military families for things that other people have done that he doesn't like. It's shameful, it's selfish, and it's stupid because it also damages our national security.
**I saw the impact for myself when I was representing the US in arms control negotiations with NATO allies and Russia from 2016 to 2019.** When you've got American officers with lower ranks going up against generals and admirals in critical meetings and negotiations — our allies, our partners, other countries, and our adversaries notice. This blockade means dozens, if not hundreds, of military officers are going to have to explain why the US is sending significantly lower ranks than their counterparts to critical meetings and negotiations around the globe.
When China sends a high-ranking general to meet with a third country and we send a one-star acting commander, that undermines our country, our position, and our national security. It's going to look like we don't care, it's going to look like we aren't serious, and people are going to question our country's resolve.

Arizona is ground zero when it comes to the climate crisis, and if you’ve been part of my campaign since the beginning, then you know it is one of the main reasons I'm running for Congress. It is already affecting all of our daily lives – and things are just going to keep getting worse unless we take historic, decisive action.

[**I hope you’ll let me explain, but if you believe we need to send a climate warrior to Congress, please make a contribution to my campaign today →**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/74144984/440753607/-1883818185?refcode=em_fr_2023.11.28_b1_ac_all&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDUwMDAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMzdjOTlkOTItMTU4ZS1lZTExLTg5MjQtNjA0NWJkZDQ3MTExIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=qbfFtECtDf-nuf3X0cHhSlMB1H2fKsqqdYgPZ1pkVLw=)

On Thursday, the United Nations is kicking off the 28th Climate Change Conference. It is one of our last chances for the world to come together to tackle the threat of climate change.

Unfortunately, the chances of real progress here were undermined early on when an oil company CEO was appointed to lead the negotiations. And now evidence is emerging that Russia and the fossil fuel industry are using the conference as leverage to sell more oil and gas.

To me, this is personal. I began my career working in the White House for then-Vice President Al Gore to sound the alarm on the climate crisis. I spent nearly a decade as the CEO of an environmentally-focused alternative to the Big Banks that put climate change fighting power into people's hands. We helped millions of Americans move billions of dollars of their savings deposits and personal investments out of the reach of Big Oil companies and into accounts that were fossil fuel-free. And we funded the planting of over one hundred million trees around the world to suck carbon dioxide out of the atmosphere.

For us here in Arizona, this isn’t some abstract or global issue. We’re facing the climate crisis right here and right now. Wildfires, drought, and deadly heat waves have become all too common.

**There is no place in America where the climate crisis is a more clear and present danger than here in Arizona. But Arizona should also be the “Solar State.” We can be to clean energy what Detroit is to cars and Silicon Valley is to computers.**

With the right leadership and vision in Congress, meeting the climate crisis can be an enormous source of economic opportunity for Arizona and America. But I need your help to get there.

[**That’s why I’m asking: Will you chip in to my people-powered campaign? Whether it’s $5, $25, $50, or $500, your support is crucial to help me get to Congress and work to address the climate crisis.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/74144985/440753608/-1883818185?refcode=em_fr_2023.11.28_b1_ac_all&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDUwMDAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMzdjOTlkOTItMTU4ZS1lZTExLTg5MjQtNjA0NWJkZDQ3MTExIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=qbfFtECtDf-nuf3X0cHhSlMB1H2fKsqqdYgPZ1pkVLw=) _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | [$5 →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/74144986/440753609/-1883818185?refcode=em_fr_2023.11.28_b1_ac_all&amount=5&express_lane=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDUwMDAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMzdjOTlkOTItMTU4ZS1lZTExLTg5MjQtNjA0NWJkZDQ3MTExIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=qbfFtECtDf-nuf3X0cHhSlMB1H2fKsqqdYgPZ1pkVLw=) | [$25 →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/74144987/440753610/-1883818185?refcode=em_fr_2023.11.28_b1_ac_all&amount=25&express_lane=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDUwMDAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMzdjOTlkOTItMTU4ZS1lZTExLTg5MjQtNjA0NWJkZDQ3MTExIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=qbfFtECtDf-nuf3X0cHhSlMB1H2fKsqqdYgPZ1pkVLw=)

**Our precious oceans are being decimated by rampant plastic waste.** Every minute, an entire garbage truck of plastics is washed into the ocean -- _**KILLING OVER A MILLION MARINE ANIMALS**_ each year, including innocent baby sea turtles that mistake plastic for food. Scientists predict that at this rate, we’ll have more plastic than fish in the ocean by 2050!
Plastic pollution poisons our air and water, kills marine wildlife, and gets into our bodies – and we need your help to curb this pollution and protect our planet. That’s why today, a generous group of donors is **matching all Giving Tuesday gifts – up to $200,000 – but only until midnight TONIGHT.[Make a $27 contribution now and help us in our fight to protect our oceans, people, and the planet while you can make twice the impact!](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2155640?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)**
It’s the public health and environmental crisis that not enough people are talking about: Plastic. Plastic will soon outweigh all the fish in the sea. It fills our rivers and oceans, chokes wildlife, permeates our drinking water and our food, and persists in the environment for centuries.
Discarded plastics don’t just disappear. They break down into smaller and smaller pieces, turning into microplastics that contaminate our water, soil, and the food we eat.
**We must take bold action on plastic pollution before this crisis gets any worse. Make your $27 donation to Friends of the Earth today and make double the impact to protect our oceans, people, and the planet. **

Scientists estimate that there are already 5.25 trillion pieces of plastic in our oceans. That’s 5.25 trillion deadly hazards that cause harm to ocean organisms -- from the smallest of corals to the largest of whales.
One plastic bag, or bottle cap, or fishing net, can suffocate, strangle, or starve its helpless victim. After their bodies decompose, the plastic is released back into the environment where it can kill again -- **because plastics do not decompose.**
More than 800 known marine species have been harmed by either plastic entanglement or ingestion of plastic -- resulting in over a million animal deaths every year.

subject: I’ll let you in on a secret:

body:
My fellow Americans - this is Mike Johnson.

| |

---
| | | My fellow Americans - this is Mike Johnson.

_**[This is a longer email but I'm humbly asking you to read it start to finish.](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=aafa3f1d88af4e29a0c7639283b8b5da&_e=RjPzvZJNNOpHP_YJJpFNzFvt-dk5duUZ52bgRYNkp9wEM1kfhu40kUoAr_zDuYv01zzCwCEPjyOSyjLOI_gLNDmVIqm2d7LA0gUsf1cVjLbFgV1tq4-D2pZCmsGVct8P4O7oKZWThbFdjQWcbdpe19vMSSQCuhW0AC0Eczqqz4e9jwYi625z2e5Sf1NeHrFt1tSBeh4XlTLDAP-Yhe7p_nDIpMu4lbUhuL1Sli0-ZPscNMNTksmCNUmbf1-S31oZn2JsKQGzRqOl5X-PWDKPTU_tIEH-HFiyOJqQjtai1Q4EJ6pYgcu3OZ4_dZ55twiDUrHOJsBNZ_kCES5lBToIxhqjOgg3XU1_27QYcRxH9BpmuMxBexuj4xEX9EFb2RfMKHsb-I_TXLOZjDJKtUlttHxrU5I7Gz0DF8-qfkvUoHJBB8-t_vJrO3VQMUl5m7Y7hXXtkOpDh2R8OYZyiQY3dXOUrvasDlsNidSTwzypcI0%3D "This is a longer email but I’m humbly asking you to read it start to finish.")**_

Why? Because the moment I was elected Speaker by my Republican colleagues, the Radical Left IMMEDIATELY unleashed a coordinated, preplanned political hit job against me.
* The Liberal Media spun up hit piece after hit piece to smear me in the press - Biden's former Press Secretary even attacked me for being a Christian on MSNBC.
* Politico fired off this headline: _" Democrats rev up the opposition machine against Mike Johnson."_
* And I can't even begin to tell you how many Democrat fundraising emails and texts I saw in the minutes following the final vote - I'm bracing myself for the next FEC reports.

Look:

These vicious attacks are a dime a dozen in Washington. They don't intimidate me. _But I 'll let you in on a little secret: that's not _really_ the goal..._

The _real_ goal of this political ambush is two-fold: **1)** smear the good names of every House Republican to hurt them electorally, and **2)** scare Liberals enough to whip out their credit cards, fill in their info, and donate to Democrats.

**It 's about power and money. Nothing else.**

That's why it's mission-critical that we stand up for ourselves in critical moments like this. _**[So as one of my first moves as Speaker, I'm teaming up with my fellow Louisianian - Majority Leader Steve Scalise - to set a goal of raising one million dollars between now and the end of the month.](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=aafa3f1d88af4e29a0c7639283b8b5da&_e=RjPzvZJNNOpHP_YJJpFNzFvt-dk5duUZ52bgRYNkp9wEM1kfhu40kUoAr_zDuYv01zzCwCEPjyOSyjLOI_gLNDmVIqm2d7LA0gUsf1cVjLbFgV1tq4-D2pZCmsGVct8P4O7oKZWThbFdjQWcbdpe19vMSSQCuhW0AC0Eczqqz4e9jwYi625z2e5Sf1NeHrFt1tSBeh4XlTLDAP-Yhe7p_nDIpMu4lbUhuL1Sli0-ZPscNMNTksmCNUmbf1-S31oZn2JsKQGzRqOl5X-PWDKPTU_tIEH-HFiyOJqQjtai1Q4EJ6pYgcu3OZ4_dZ55twiDH6QGwIOsxAAdL0_q_pCMo_kCIJcofocPIKzm_JH1OsxMdnccCzTwr0qdbCUw_puy-yNeVaH8cupwzyb3lA1Q51ZtfyT3ABwyWcG2p9-vJByIYm8k6XCj8Wos3eBFGnFFX2DQCTmK5ToZf7E6HikYTEsSl2m_NZrQjBZ_t1Qk-80%3D "So as one of my first moves as Speaker, I’m teaming up with my fellow Louisianian – Majority Leader Steve Scalise – to set a goal of raising one million dollars between now and the end of the month.")**_

It's ambitious. I get it. But that's the bare minimum we need to fully fund our campaign operations in battleground races across the country.

**If we fall short of that, we 'll be forced to SLASH our voter contact budgets, GUT our digital outreach efforts, and pull our ads OFF THE AIRWAVES. Nothing could be worse for our plans to defend and expand our slim House Majority.**

So here's my final pitch to you:

We urgently need your help. Not next week, not in the new year - right here and right now.

The difference between a strong Conservative Majority and one controlled by the Liberal Machine will come down to can't-miss fundraising goals just like this.

Let me make myself perfectly clear:

_I 'm not asking you to pitch in more than you can afford. If you can spare $50 or $100, I would be tremendously grateful. But if you can only spare $5 or $10, I would be equally appreciative._

_**[The ONLY thing I ask is for every Conservative in the country to chip in SOMETHING.](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=aafa3f1d88af4e29a0c7639283b8b5da&_e=RjPzvZJNNOpHP_YJJpFNzFvt-dk5duUZ52bgRYNkp9wEM1kfhu40kUoAr_zDuYv01zzCwCEPjyOSyjLOI_gLNDmVIqm2d7LA0gUsf1cVjLbFgV1tq4-D2pZCmsGVct8P4O7oKZWThbFdjQWcbdpe19vMSSQCuhW0AC0Eczqqz4e9jwYi625z2e5Sf1NeHrFt1tSBeh4XlTLDAP-Yhe7p_nDIpMu4lbUhuL1Sli0-ZPscNMNTksmCNUmbf1-S31oZn2JsKQGzRqOl5X-PWDKPTU_tIEH-HFiyOJqQjtai1Q4EJ6pYgcu3OZ4_dZ55twiDAPJj8O6yRA7aMovtPmKLFGoxRoa6_6HgYUAA8eTqf_ke9V3DuLT5mkANqx7OUSAxU_Cc1Kf-XaNfFO9pkxVMdIDMeD1xzqrPl45meqFY7uqtTI57rCD-t-N78pfNN3USpxbkdY4xC2uuVUrt9ssPWDAjlDiRE21EHH-t2xSKN1o%3D "The ONLY thing I ask is for every Conservative in the country to chip in SOMETHING.")**_

| Whether you're saving for retirement, considering major purchases, planning your estate, or just want a second set of eyes on your investments, hiring a financial advisor who you feel best suits your needs could be key. A 2022 Northwestern Mutual study found that 62% of U.S. adults admit their financial planning needs improvement. However, only 35% of Americans work with a financial advisor.1 The value of working with a financial advisor varies by person. While advisors are legally prohibited from promising returns, research suggests that people who [work with a financial advisor](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=15a64669d7e9498394ac27788d6be045&_e=aSDqwY-e88V18GZTj0zptGVqSw-EY9usSApUXGP-vT1vFdkgdiovM96V7BWWy_d9jUBlpeFoOKN_4DQgfobdGp4oLgU9fwKSAW9EQJsB-hCbqWnDWaLrPax5z2FXFxfxS5s79mbZGW00uWExkn31id2RBlO0aH9zpfYFP-a1rU72Em2ZvuwnN8sP-mftZbNarXE_kQYyvW0MG_kmPB03U-46jEu8LaIPiChaYiipTJGPcUtMhloyU1Ib26NSDNjCywvmzG9Ct7f802Y_gDgXw3XeYwDEszlgQMgiK0ewQhtKaJLAlxJUJO1FfSvzbgvGzfHE9aKsKjKVDi3sP2O_932k33clwx4F9oK_mO4GjFeyb7h019ckEy5Ar6pDG6JThZcHwLGYdac-crijxpr5o4b3vdqt6-6RDIf1RFENRrisdKZjyoPQriGwP76fXFPEDqJ7xFrA8UDJqOucy7kbPQ%3D%3D) feel more at ease about their finances and could potentially end up with about 15% more money to spend in retirement.2 Whatever your reasons for seeking financial advice, it's important to have a list of questions planned to ensure you're hiring a financial advisor who can help you plan to reach your goals.
### **5 Questions to Ask When Choosing a Financial Advisor**
**1\. Are You a Fiduciary?** Fiduciaries are financial advisors with a legal obligation to prioritize your interests as they manage your assets or money. Unlike a broker who may push you into insurance policies or investments to rack up fees and commissions, fiduciaries are bound to recommend options that benefit you, the customer. name: David Horowitz
subject: I’m not saying this to scare you
body:
America is on the brink of destruction.

| |
---
| | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don’t say this to shock or scare you – I say it because it’s true. _What we see today didn’t happen overnight. It’s the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **...and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I’d know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ – radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my “comrades” made possible. So I left and never looked back. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan – then I started the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left and I’ve dedicated the last 40 years to exposing them. Why? Because I knew first-hand the threat our country was facing. I knew what was at stake and I knew if I didn’t tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever. That’s why I spent 6 months writing** _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_** – and I want you to have your very own copy of it. **[So I’m asking you to stand with me and make a generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to my Freedom Center. As a thank you, I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zunsrbnq4vftqsu0b1i4c11asooun5febsjo1n18_rp22sh2s8i6eo34c9i64pj6c3h2bs)** When you think of “the enemy within” you may think of Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi or even Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez...and you wouldn’t be wrong. But make no mistake: **The real mastermind is Barack Obama.** Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we’ve seen since 2020 back in 2008. Barack Obama led the destruction of our cities, cozying up to Black Lives Matter radicals and siding with criminals over police upholding the rule of law. Barack Obama championed the castration of our military, making us a laughingstock on the world stage. And Barack Obama was the true architect behind the bogus Russian collusion witch hunt. The devastation and destruction we see today has been over a decade in the making – but most of the American people have no clue what we’re up against. **That’s why I wrote _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_ to explain how communist and fascist Leftists infiltrated and overtook the Democrat Party...** ...how it has become a party of racism and hatred attacking the very foundations of our country... ... and how their ultimate goal is to create a one-party state – and cancel, deplatform and silence every last one of their political opponents by slandering them as “white supremacists” and worse. The reviews speak for themselves... “A Great Book” – Dinesh D’Souza “ _The Enemy Within_ is a book for all patriots who understand that our country is in a fight for its life.” – Mark Levin “David Horowitz does it again in a must-read for any American concerned about where we are headed as a nation.” Laura Ingraham I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because... I know if our country stands a chance, Americans must understand exactly how sinister and dangerous the new Democrat Party actually is. I was the enemy within — and I know in my bones what it will take to defeat them. We’ve reached the point in our history that will decide our future – and we either win these political battles or lose everything that makes us prosperous and free. **[That’s why I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within when you donate $35 or more to the Freedom Center today and give us the ammunition we need to expose the Left’s evil agenda to every American patriot.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zdb8ne1g2hbp925visraraduapeseic04098ks80_rp22sh2s8i6eo34c9i64pj6c3h2bs)** The Left is at war with America. They don’t simply disagree with us about how to make our country better – they want to destroy it to make way for their Marxist dystopia. Or in Obama’s own words “radically transform” America. **And they don’t care how much they have to lie, cheat or steal to achieve it.** So it’s up to patriots like you and me to expose the truth about the Left to our fellow Americans while we still can.
---
| | Sincerely,
---
---
David Horowitz
---
P.S. I know how we got to this point in our country, and I know how we get out. But the clock is ticking and our country is hanging by a thread. **[Please make a generous donation of $35 or more to the Freedom Center today and as a thank you, I’ll rush a complimentary copy of my book The Enemy Within to you.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z3il2nf0m3dn9hh3243h1pjts9314854bvgbb980_rp22sh2s8i6eo34c9i64pj6c3h2bs)**

body:
Everyone’s eyes are on us.
# [](https://go.bobcasey.com/go/181?t=1&akid=1239%2E552475%2EQSqeUc)
Peter,
It's no secret that Bob Casey's re-election campaign will be one of the most competitive (and expensive) Senate races of 2024. All eyes are on us -- from Mitch McConnell, to our Democratic allies, to the national press.
That's why it's SO important we hit every goal we set and continue working as hard as possible to re-elect Bob. **But over the holiday weekend, donations slowed... and we need to catch up.**

It’s not looking good

| Peter – I’ve worked in politics for half a century, so believe me when I tell you: **Democrats are in BIG trouble.**

The 2024 Senate map is the toughest one I’ve ever seen. Our razor-thin majority is hanging on by a single thread, and there’s no question that Mitch McConnell and his extremist cronies will use every trick up their sleeves to snatch back power.

**The GOP is coming at us with full force – and with experts saying that Nevada could once again decide Senate control, they’re zeroing in on Jacky Rosen as a TOP target for defeat. Now, brand new polling shows the Nevada Senate race in a statistical dead heat!!! It’s not looking good.**

[_**Jacky needs to raise another $20,000 by midnight tonight to fight back against GOP attacks and fuel her campaign forward – but the ONLY way she can get there is with your immediate grassroots support. So PLEASE, will you split a $10 donation between her campaign and Fight for Progress right now?**_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/74148828/440767773/-220169546?refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2023-11-28_1&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImYwMjdkOGU4LTFhOGUtZWUxMS04OTI0LTYwNDViZGQ0NzExMSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=AzypueYNZ6QHmW0EU3CWLe8xjPChVfhLYNcqZzgIFmM=)

**If Jacky loses in Nevada, McConnell and his far-right posse will take back the majority and enact their dangerous, out-of-touch agenda. We CAN'T let this happen.**

In my expert opinion, we CAN win this race and keep control of the Senate – but that starts with raising the resources _today_ to prepare for the tough fight ahead.

Thank you for being part of this incredible team. I’ve seen many grassroots campaigns in my lifetime, and I know this one has what it takes to win.

James Carville

name: Alexandra Rojas
subject: Diplomacy works
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Last week, a four-day temporary cessation of hostilities was announced
between Israel and Hamas, along with a limited exchange of hostages.

Since then, Israelis and Palestinians have been returned to their loved
ones, and the relentless bombing on Gaza that has killed an estimated
15,000 Palestinians has finally paused for the moment.

This truce proves that a diplomatic solution is not only possible, but the
only way to protect the lives of Israelis and Palestinians alike. This
first step comes after more than a month of protests and public pressure
demanding the U.S. government call for a ceasefire. While this incomplete
agreement is only temporary, it makes it clear that there is no military
solution to this conflict — and we must continue calling for a permanent
ceasefire, which does not include $14 billion more in bombs and weapons
for the Israeli military to continue its destruction.

The Squad led on this issue when others were too afraid to, being the
first members of Congress to introduce and support a resolution calling
for an immediate ceasefire and release of all hostages.

Now, those same progressive champions are continuing to push for a
permanent ceasefire and diplomatic solutions to achieve peace, despite
facing unprecedented attacks from Republican-funded Super PACs like AIPAC.

As the Squad keeps up their fight for human rights for all, Justice
Democrats is preparing to do everything in our power to re-elect them next
year. [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231128.JC1D41&refcode=em20231128-32072&amount=3&t=1001&akid=32072%2E1203867%2Exdyivf ]Can you chip in $3 or anything you can afford today
to help us reach our grassroots fundraising goal before Thursday’s
deadline?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231128.JC1D41&refcode=em20231128-32072&amount=3&t=1020&akid=32072%2E1203867%2Exdyivf ]Contribute $3

Together, we can and must continue to fuel our movement for peace and
human rights, and that means defending our bloc of young, Black and brown,
working-class progressives in Congress.

Thanks for everything you do to power us,

Alexandra Rojas
Executive Director

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time.

There are other ways to make an impact in support of peace and equality in
Israel and Palestine: please urge your member of Congress to support a
ceasefire through [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/139873?t=1021&akid=32072%2E1203867%2Exdyivf ]Adalah Justice Project’s petition or by calling them
using [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/139874?t=1022&akid=32072%2E1203867%2Exdyivf ]Jewish Voice for Peace’s dialer here. Your voice matters in this
critical moment.

| | We know a lot of worthy organizations are asking for your attention today, so we’ll be quick. [**Here are three things your Giving Tuesday donation to Fair Fight Action’s Civic Education and Voter Protection Fund would help achieve:**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/74150519/440773330/297579042?refcode=bsc_emm_ffa_20231128_f_givingtuesday_v1s1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3Y2U3NjY1Zi0xZThlLWVlMTEtODkyNC02MDQ1YmRkNDcxMTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ya0kjNGhDlo1CyfGndMgfvGwwP3cGm2kWBVR_15tn7U=)
1. De-escalating threats, harassment, and intimidation around elections in Georgia and across the country — including mitigating online disinformation and convening a national coalition around de-escalation.
2. Ensuring that Georgia voters have accurate, up-to-date information about vote-by-mail procedures and early in-person voting locations, through an online one-stop-shop and voter education efforts focused on Black, brown, and young Georgia voters.
3. Providing voting rights and voter protection partners, as well as the public, with up-to-date information about the impact of voting-related laws and litigation.

name: Adam Schiff
subject: Growing up
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR SENATE
body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=4598%2E5257348%2EDkt0Z4 ]Adam Schiff for Senate

Hi Derek, can
I share a photo with you?

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=nov2023_abs_em_eom.8xjxgy&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOM_AC30_20231128_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=4598%2E5257348%2EDkt0Z4 ]Adam with his parents

These are my parents, Ed and Sherry.

I want to take a moment to explain the values and principles that my
parents instilled in me throughout my life.

My parents taught me so much – that public service was a noble calling and
one that could bring meaningful change.

It’s why I first joined the Department of Justice and why I first ran for
office. I wanted to deliver for my community and country and make a
difference.

Their support and encouragement have helped me get to this point today.

You see, growing up, my parents surrounded my brother and me with books
and records, with frequent conversations about topics from history to
politics. Sitting around the dinner table at night, our family would talk
about the news of the day or the history book my father was reading at the
moment.

The conversations were always dynamic — my dad comes from a long line of
Democrats, and my mom from a long line of Republicans (in fact, her father
was a Republican county chairman at one point, so you can imagine the
discourse at larger family gatherings!).

To this day, my father, now almost 96, continues to love talking politics
(and has a few choice words for the former president).

The values instilled by my parents are the values I hope I’ve instilled in
my children too: To stand up for what you believe in and against bullies.
To be understanding and thoughtful, to help others whenever you can, and
to listen and learn.

My parents taught me that honesty really matters. That truth matters, that
decency matters, and that our democracy matters. And it’s up to each one
of us to use the skills we have to fight for them.

And that’s why I’m asking you today:

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=nov2023_abs_em_eom.8xjxgy&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOM_AC30_20231128_PM1_V1_S1&email=&amount=3&t=1005&akid=4598%2E5257348%2EDkt0Z4 ]Will you chip in
$3 to our
campaign to help power my efforts to uphold our democracy’s values? Our
campaign is just a few days away from our end-of-month fundraising

Dear Friend,

Charles Dickens, a very great novelist, had a special gift for revealing important truths in delightful ways through unforgettable characters.

To mark this holiday season, Hillsdale College is releasing a new online course on what is perhaps Dickens' most beloved novel: _A Christmas Carol_.

The course is taught by the excellent Dwight Lindley, an English professor here at Hillsdale who loves both reading Dickens and teaching Dickens.

In this six-lecture course, Dwight will help you understand more fully the causes of Ebenezer Scrooge's conversion in the novel and what the story teaches us about leading a happy and complete life.

You can use the secure link below to begin experiencing the wisdom and fun of _A Christmas Carol_ today.

**[https://online.hillsdale.edu/prereg/christmas-carol](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=99323b5b6cb84d2ba5c7a41dbdd5ed53&_e=afV0etDI9j8Zj0VNyZhix3PWVbnGyYWM8pM3pURJXcMbjXv06hyg9im5PY4246HDucxL7HF6KcQ3fWa27unEyllr32HyVEmWcYi-_Lbf--1kVMVxvwwmRd5F3HvaZW8SGDTTH0-3wKH4YFq-u9cSLluZFw22ai5c9UMpTDrnZ6Sy2SorwSTZ2ZsKPSURywGs0rjAUmf5IgZqYCxpk_K_E_TuFyHbGInQ9siFZVRwRjrWavgFvci5nT-aOyHPedMDCS85iwEN_WwsMY_KP2uQH1-IAkbJfiIqcXFSGebhF-JYFwNo6IqiHzqyHNow0DBAcVmWJLhblv-W5hmU8fCYVOqNEwFhm4LIQjBV7dWDl0z3KxAkxhErh8A5I9xFH3wJuDez6RLRz6bc5wQ-1yb2ig%3D%3D)**

Let your family and friends know of this free online course as well. We hope it will add meaning and joy to your Christmas celebrations.

Best regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College

body:

Hi Peter, there's a reason I've got today marked on the calendar. Every week, my team and I get on a call to check in, go over the plan for the week and make sure everyone is on the same page. This week – because I'm sure we'll be talking about the budget – I wanted to reach out and make sure you knew how crucial your support is to my campaign. [**Will you chip in any amount you can spare to support my campaign?**](https://emily4mi.com/l/SZ0wGBWMDd1j) As my team and I move forward, folks like you are essential to connecting with voters across the district, sharing my story and helping us prepare to continue in 2024. There's a lot at stake for the 10th District, including the safety of our children, and my opponent has proven time and time again that his commitment to his party trumps any commitment to his constituents.
---
**I'm running not only to keep our communities safe, but to give them the strong voice in Congress they deserve.**
---
[**But I want to be honest with you, Peter. My team and I are counting on your help to set my campaign up for success next year. With one of our last big fundraising deadlines approaching fast, will you join my team with a donation today?**](https://emily4mi.com/l/ee06cqH6t7QW)
---
[ **JOIN OUR TEAM** ](https://emily4mi.com/l/hWd3DNBBiOUz)
---
Thank you,
Emily Busch
---
|
---
| | | [](https://emily4mi.com/l/AbfCGuc4Ik6D)

Emily first learned the importance of community and helping others from her mom, a nurse, and dad, a manufacturing representative, while growing up in a tight-knit, middle-class Midwestern family.

The proud product of public schools, Emily worked hard in and out of the classroom, balancing her studies and interest in performing arts with an after-school job as a cashier at Ace Hardware. She went on to earn her B.A. in Biology from Indiana University and Masters from Michigan State University.

Now, Emily is running for Congress in Michigan’s 10th District to keep our kids safe, protect our rights, and lower costs for Michigan families.

Emily chose to move to Oakland County two decades ago because it was the place she wanted to raise her family – a place with friendly neighbors, good schools, and safe neighborhoods.

She and her husband, a retired firefighter and Marine, enjoy camping, fishing, and visiting national parks in their free time.

name: Friends of the Earth
subject: Our wolves are struggling to survive without you. 2X your gift for wildlife and our planet now!
body:
| | | | | [](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/e_s17_main_cobrandedemail_c3)
---|---|---

| | | Right now, majestic gray wolves are being brutally murdered – including vulnerable young pups. **Three young gray wolves – some of the first wild-born pups in Colorado in over 80 years – were SHOT TO DEATH near the Wyoming border. **Now their last surviving pack members, and the future of wolves in the wild, are in extreme danger.
---
Cruel trophy hunters and their Big Polluter allies are feeding this tragedy. **Wolves can’t fight back against this coordinated effort to DECIMATE their packs and the lands they roam for “fun” and profits. That’s why Friends of the Earth is standing up to fight for our essential wildlife, the ecosystems they’re a part of and our planet.** But we’re counting on you to take action with us now, on one of our most important days of the year.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/e_s23_nov_gtmatch23-esa-wolves-mw_efundraiser_27_c3?refcode=fs-28-1855)
**We’ve set an ambitious Giving Tuesday goal to help protect wildlife and our planet from senseless violence and greed. Right now, a generous group of donors will MATCH all gifts, dollar-for-dollar, up to $200,000, but only until midnight TONIGHT to continue this urgent fight. [Please: Will you make a membership gift of $27 or more now – and have it DOUBLED – to help hit our goal and protect the Earth and its vulnerable inhabitants?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/e_s23_nov_gtmatch23-esa-wolves-mw_efundraiser_27_c3?refcode=fs-28-1855&amount=27)**
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | | [Donate $27 immediately →](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/e_s23_nov_gtmatch23-esa-wolves-mw_efundraiser_27_c3?refcode=fs-28-1855&express_lane=true&amount=27)
---
| | [Donate $50 immediately → ](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/e_s23_nov_gtmatch23-esa-wolves-mw_efundraiser_27_c3?refcode=fs-28-1855&express_lane=true&amount=50)
---
| | [Donate $100 immediately → ](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/e_s23_nov_gtmatch23-esa-wolves-mw_efundraiser_27_c3?refcode=fs-28-1855&express_lane=true&amount=100)
---
| | [Double another amount](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/e_s23_nov_gtmatch23-esa-wolves-mw_efundraiser_27_c3?refcode=fs-28-1855)
---
Here’s what we’re up against: **When federal protections for gray wolves were rolled back, trophy hunters went on an ALL-OUT KILLING SPREE. Hundreds of wolves were violently murdered in a matter of days!** Now, surviving wolf populations are still lacking critical protections, and the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (FWS) is failing to prevent more senseless slaughter.

That means, despite DECADES of tireless work, conservationists can’t protect our wolves and our public lands on their own. **Wolves who enjoy safety on one side of state lines can be MERCILESSLY TORTURED if they step into deadly, pro-hunting territory. The only way forward is to strengthen the Endangered Species Act (ESA). **
**But the fossil fuel industry doesn’t want that to happen.****The ESA is one of our strongest tools to PREVENT destructive drilling, mining and logging projects on the public lands vital species call home. That’s why fossil fuel companies have teamed up with the hunting lobby to attack the ESA at every turn. If they get their way, gray wolves could lose their last best chance at survival – and our ecosystems will pay the price of climate-wrecking destruction and pollution. **
**The stakes couldn’t be higher, and we MUST fight back with everything we have. Friends of the Earth is working tirelessly to strengthen the ESA, protecting wildlife and the planet. That’s why exhausting this $200,000 Giving Tuesday match opportunity is so crucial, and we can’t do this without your support. Every dollar has a role to play in sustaining our fight against private interests, greedy corporations and their anti-environment agenda. **[So please don’t wait: Make a membership gift of $27 or more now – while $27 becomes $54 – to help Friends of the Earth fight for our wildlife and the only Earth we’ll ever get.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/e_s23_nov_gtmatch23-esa-wolves-mw_efundraiser_27_c3?refcode=fs-28-1855&amount=27)

We are so grateful to have you by our side in the fight to protect our planet.

Raena Garcia

Because it's my first deadline, we need to show that we can hit big benchmarks before the end of the year and we must jumpstart my voter outreach funding. clean_body: | | | | | | | | | Can you believe it? After an exciting two weeks, we're already up against an end-of-month fundraising deadline. Why does this matter? Because it's my first deadline, we need to show that we can hit big benchmarks before the end of the year and we must jumpstart my voter outreach funding. Reaching voters throughout Alaska isn't easy, so we've set aggressive goals each month. And believe me, people will be watching to see if we have what it takes to beat Mary Peltola. Right now, we're short $2,357 from our digital goal. This campaign is fueled by voters like you, who understand the struggles and dreams of our families. Tomorrow, I will ask my team to send over an updated list of November supporters who contributed, and I hope to see your name. Warm regards, Nancy Dahlstrom Candidate for Congress, Alaska At-Large | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | No longer want to receive these emails? .

subject: It’s all connected: why Washington doesn't work for working people

# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=33882%2E3422442%2ELw_xnr)
Derek,
As a mom of three, I’m used to mess. But let me tell you...there’s a LOT of work to be done to clean up Washington so that Congress actually works for working people, not just the ultra-rich.
**That’s why I’m proud to be “doing Congress” differently than most:**
* I don’t take a dime from corporate PACs or federal lobbyists, and I’m one of just eleven Members to make that commitment. I also don’t take money from Big Oil, Big Pharma, or Big Bank CEOs.
* Congress brought back “earmarks” in 2021, after they had been banned in 2011 because the process led to corruption and waste. I was the only Democrat to oppose them.
* I’m leading the fight to ban Members of Congress and their spouses from trading stocks. It’s plain wrong that Members are getting rich off information we learn in private briefings.

Derek, I wouldn’t be able to compete in this outrageously expensive Senate race if it wasn’t for grassroots support.
