subject: C.S. Lewis’s Profound Insights
body:
C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life's most important questions
188d92cdddd40f90da47bc74ea2ba8fb
| This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/qf48VObDPrjzqhqarm97Ng~~/AARclAA~/RgRnSO_~~)
---
| | Dear friend, C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life's most important questions through vivid language that is delightful and captivating to read.

His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more believers to renew and deepen their faith--making him the greatest Christian apologist of the twentieth century.

That's why we produced "[**C.S. Lewis on Christianity,**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/qf48VObDPrjzqhqarm97Ng~~/AARclAA~/RgRnSO_~~)" which you can now own on DVD.
---
| [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/qf48VObDPrjzqhqarm97Ng~~/AARclAA~/RgRnSO_~~)
---
| | In this course you will learn Lewis's profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis 's The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis's Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis's beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis's own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

That's why I hope you'll join us in examining the eternal questions of Christianity with C.S. Lewis with [this beautiful new DVD box set](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/qf48VObDPrjzqhqarm97Ng~~/AARclAA~/RgRnSO_~~).

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, '09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College
---

Hi there, Friend.

It's Speaker Mike Johnson.

You probably hadn't heard much about me until just a few weeks ago. Since then, no doubt you've heard a lot about me- some of it true, most of it lies whipped up by the fake news media.

_**In any case, let me take this opportunity to formally introduce myself.**_

I was born and raised in Shreveport, LA, where I learned to be a humble servant of God from a young age.

Before being elected to Congress in 2016, I spent nearly two decades as a Constitutional lawyer, where I was a leading defender of the right to life, religious liberty, free speech, free market principles, the word of God, and our great Constitution.

I am, and continue to be, proud of all the work I have done to defend traditional values and preserve the American way of life up until this point. **But more than anything else in my life, I am a proud father to my four beautiful children and a loving husband to my wife, Kelly. **

body:
The Truth about Biden's Economy and Krysty's working miracles in the kitchen over Thanksgiving! | | | | | |
---
[](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=ae325b101b&e=567664f14c)

We're excited to share the [**newest episode**](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=fff4275a3b&e=567664f14c) of the No Doubt About It podcast with Mark and Krysty Ronchetti, and it's a delightful blend of holiday replays from our kitchen to how Biden has his hands full selling a deteriorating economy.
[](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=aabb6a739d&e=567664f14c)
In this episode, Mark and Krysty take you behind the scenes of their Thanksgiving celebrations, with a special focus on Krysty's wizard-like culinary skills in the kitchen. From doubts about her turkey-brining technique to a triumphant Thanksgiving feast, it's a tale of culinary success (that was very much in doubt!).
| [STREAM EPISODE 55 NOW](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=d778ca2153&e=567664f14c)
---
The episode takes an entertaining turn when Mark makes a comical Black Friday purchase—a Christmas tree that, well, doesn't quite fit in the house as planned.
Shifting gears, we tackle pressing political issues, including the Biden administration's attempt to convince Americans that the economy is thriving despite the harsh inflation affecting family budgets. We discuss media narratives and the questionable portrayal of the economy amidst widespread suffering.
| [STREAM EPISODE 55 NOW](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=bc3c635a0f&e=567664f14c)
---
The conversation then takes a serious turn as we shed light on Hamas releasing hostages taken from Israel and the disturbing tactics used to divert attention from their violent actions. It's a stark reminder of what October 7th really was.
Ending on a lighter note, the episode wraps up with a discussion about the best cheeseburger in New Mexico, adding a touch of culinary exploration to the mix.
| [STREAM EPISODE 55 NOW](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=a58b1250b9&e=567664f14c)
---
|

If you enjoy the show and want to support us, visit [NoDoubtAboutItPodcast.com](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=67554fab82&e=567664f14c), where you can purchase gear and make financial donations. Your support means the world to us!
Thank you for being part of the No Doubt About It community, and we look forward to sharing more entertaining and thought-provoking discussions with you in the future.
Best regards,Mark and Krysty Ronchetti

| | Peter, **One thing I've always been thankful for is community members who stretch themselves to breaking to make things just a bit better for their friends and neighbors.** That's what this season means to me these days: a chance to sit with loved ones and celebrate the sacrifices of everyone who gives pieces of themselves for their communities. I'm talking about teachers and nurses, organizers and activists, parents and guardians — everyone who is out there working for a better tomorrow in their own, critical way. Giving Tuesday is an extension of that moment: it's a time to put our money where our mouths are, to support the causes and individuals who are fighting to make a difference on so many fronts. [**I know you have many choices today, many causes or candidates you might support for giving Tuesday. I'd be honored to be one of them.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/74155636/440790656/1183499175?refcode=2023-11-28-eom&recurring=&amount=16&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=91683a7e-278e-ee11-8924-6045bdd47111&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDQxNjIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOTE2ODNhN2UtMjc4ZS1lZTExLTg5MjQtNjA0NWJkZDQ3MTExIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=OoPpqzMaa2rPjSp_5-sNNhSJABulu9IBL25xZo9B51g=) Grassroots political campaigns are an investment. You're not committing to vote for an individual — it's a moment instead to say, _I like what this person is bringing to the table and I want to hear more._ **So here's just a little bit of what I'm about, Peter:**
* I'm a member of the L.A. School Board. I got my start as a middle school English teacher, but I also took on LAUSD and later joined the Obama Administration — where I worked on civil rights issues.

* I'm running for Congress because I believe we need a big change of direction in Washington D.C. _Enough_ extremism. _Enough_ chaos.

* The priorities are all wrong out there. It's time for candidates and leaders who will say _no more_ to efforts to criminalize reproductive freedoms, climate science denial, and special favors for special interests and the ultra-wealthy.

[**Does that sound like a debate you want to have? Then I'd be honored if you chipped in just $16 to get this campaign off the ground for Giving Tuesday.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/74155637/440790657/1183499175?refcode=2023-11-28-eom&recurring=&amount=16&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=91683a7e-278e-ee11-8924-6045bdd47111&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDQxNjIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOTE2ODNhN2UtMjc4ZS1lZTExLTg5MjQtNjA0NWJkZDQ3MTExIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=OoPpqzMaa2rPjSp_5-sNNhSJABulu9IBL25xZo9B51g=) Because this campaign is just truly getting started. clean_body: Decide for yourself if these ideas are worth talking about: | | | | Peter, One thing I've always been thankful for is community members who stretch themselves to breaking to make things just a bit better for their friends and neighbors. That's what this season means to me these days: a chance to sit with loved ones and celebrate the sacrifices of everyone who gives pieces of themselves for their communities. I'm talking about teachers and nurses, organizers and activists, parents and guardians — everyone who is out there working for a better tomorrow in their own, critical way. Giving Tuesday is an extension of that moment: it's a time to put our money where our mouths are, to support the causes and individuals who are fighting to make a difference on so many fronts. = Grassroots political campaigns are an investment. You're not committing to vote for an individual — it's a moment instead to say, I like what this person is bringing to the table and I want to hear more. So here's just a little bit of what I'm about, Peter: I'm a member of the L.A. School Board. I got my start as a middle school English teacher, but I also took on LAUSD and later joined the Obama Administration — where I worked on civil rights issues. I'm running for Congress because I believe we need a big change of direction in Washington D.C. Enough extremism. Enough chaos. The priorities are all wrong out there. It's time for candidates and leaders who will say no more to efforts to criminalize reproductive freedoms, climate science denial, and special favors for special interests and the ultra-wealthy. = Because this campaign is just truly getting started. And I think these ideas and values are critical for America's future, and deserve a spot in the debate over America's future. clean_body: With a few hours to go, help Fairness Project reach their goal >> | | Dear friend, My name is David Benson, and I work on the State and Local Campaigns team at the American Cancer Society Cancer Action Network. But today, I’m reaching out to you as someone who has witnessed firsthand the power of collective action and compassion in advocating for accessible health care. Fairness Project continue the fight for accessible health care for all by contributing toward their Giving Tuesday goal today? = Last year, alongside our partners at the Fairness Project, we achieved a monumental victory in South Dakota: the successful passage of the Medicaid expansion ballot measure. This expansion is a lifeline for thousands, aiding diverse groups such as parents, farmers, near-retirees, small business employees, and individuals in jobs without health care benefits or who simply cannot afford them. It's a practical and successful approach to closing the health care coverage gap. Thanks to the passage of this ballot measure, which raises the income threshold, more South Dakotans can qualify for the Medicaid program including childless adults — a group often overlooked in health care coverage. That’s over 50,000 South Dakotans that can access affordable health care right now. And we couldn’t have made it happen without the support of the Fairness Project. From providing critical support to qualify for the ballot to assisting in policy development and polling, they play a pivotal role in states like South Dakota — where investing in ballot measures can often be overlooked. However, our work is far from over. To continue our efforts in championing health care equity and supporting initiatives like Medicaid expansion, we need your help. This Giving Tuesday, the Fairness Project has set a goal to raise $10,000. During my time as Pennsylvania’s Auditor General, I co-chaired a School Safety Task Force with Governor Tom Wolf. Together, we held meetings across the Commonwealth with students, teachers, administrators, and law enforcement experts about how best to protect students. After these discussions, we released a final report, which detailed 32 recommendations to help keep students safer in schools, including increasing access to mental health resources and increasing the presence of school resource officers. **And just a few months after releasing our report, many of our Task Force recommendations began to be implemented in communities across Pennsylvania.** As a father to two children, I’m so proud to do my part to protect Pennsylvania students — but I also know that work isn’t finished. Students should _always_ feel safe at school — and that’s exactly what I’ll fight for as Pennsylvania’s next Attorney General. name: Team Cori
subject: We’re supporting Rise this Giving Tuesday
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Cori Bush for Congress
body:
Rise has been working to connect communities with local institutions to empower the revitalization of neighborhoods in Greater St. Louis for over 30 years | |
---

Friend, This month, Jim Jordan was in the news a lot as he (unsuccessfully) attempted to become Speaker of the House of Representatives. Jordan’s vain quest for power resurfaced a story that had received too little attention for far too long: the sexual abuse scandal at OSU and the survivors’ pursuit of justice and accountability. At the center of this is a group called **The Alumni Survivors of Ohio State University** , a group of survivors and allies working to raise awareness of a sexual abuse scandal that has been covered up by OSU for over 50 years. For decades, a doctor at Ohio State University named Richard Strauss sexually abused close to two thousand reported student athletes. Credible and detailed reports of the abuse were frequently swept under the rug or simply ignored. My opponent Jim Jordan’s role in the systematic abuse that took place under his watch when he was a wrestling coach is an important question that the survivors group will no doubt look to answer. But my request for your support for these courageous individuals goes beyond politics. This isn’t just about Jim Jordan. **It is about making sure that abusers and their enablers, and everyone involved in a system of abuse, see justice—and to send a message that we will not tolerate abuse, not now, not ever.** So today, on Giving Tuesday, I want to ask that you consider a donation in support of these fearless survivors. **[The Alumni Survivors of Ohio State University have started a GoFundMe account](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/74157663/440797487/-1445447707?utm_campaign=p_cp+share-sheet&utm_content=undefined&utm_medium=copy_link_all&utm_source=customer&utm_term=undefined&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS8xMDAwNjciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYjkzNDU0NjktMmE4ZS1lZTExLTg5MjQtNjA0NWJkZDQ3MTExIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=ljgSlbqxZz1zY7n-3mkGFShSserzTyy8fM9-fiG8kGU=&emci=d148b0c1-168e-ee11-8924-6045bdd47111&emdi=b9345469-2a8e-ee11-8924-6045bdd47111&ceid=10450908)** to raise funds to pay for a long-term billboard advertisement near the OSU campus. At the center of this is a group called The Alumni Survivors of Ohio State University , a group of survivors and allies working to raise awareness of a sexual abuse scandal that has been covered up by OSU for over 50 years. For decades, a doctor at Ohio State University named Richard Strauss sexually abused close to two thousand reported student athletes. Credible and detailed reports of the abuse were frequently swept under the rug or simply ignored. My opponent Jim Jordan’s role in the systematic abuse that took place under his watch when he was a wrestling coach is an important question that the survivors group will no doubt look to answer. But my request for your support for these courageous individuals goes beyond politics. This isn’t just about Jim Jordan. It is about making sure that abusers and their enablers, and everyone involved in a system of abuse, see justice—and to send a message that we will not tolerate abuse, not now, not ever. So today, on Giving Tuesday, I want to ask that you consider a donation in support of these fearless survivors. to raise funds to pay for a long-term billboard advertisement near the OSU campus. You can donate to their fundraiser here: | | I am proud to stand with these survivors in their pursuit of justice. Thank you for your support for a worthy cause on Giving Tuesday! -Tamie Wilson | | | = | Tamie Wilson Candidate for Congress (OH-4) | | | = To contribute via check, please address to: Tamie Wilson for US 273 SARATOGA ST. My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

Neonics, the most widely used insecticides worldwide, are TOXIC to bees, to people like you and me, and to our planet. **The time to fight back is NOW – a group of generous donors has agreed to match all Giving Tuesday gifts, up to $200,000, but only until midnight TONIGHT.** Make a membership donation now that will go TWICE AS FAR in protecting pollinators, people, and the planet: _If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | [Donate $27 immediately](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2156661?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

---
An "insect apocalypse."
A "second Silent Spring."
A "catastrophic collapse of nature's ecosystems."
This is how scientists are describing the loss of bees and other insects. Neonicotinoid pesticides are a key driver of this crisis. They can impact bees' ability to navigate and reproduce, and even KILL BEES ON CONTACT.
There’s no question that pollinator populations are rapidly spiraling. **Last year alone, the U.S. lost nearly HALF of all honeybee colonies.** And in just 20 years, one of our country’s most populous species of bumblebee, the Western Bumblebee, plummeted by 93%! The increased usage of toxic pesticides is making things worse.
The EPA has a chance to ban neonics once and for all. Instead, it might _**approve these pesticides for another 15 years**_. But there's still hope, Friend. Because of supporters like you, we have the chance to make real change -- change that would help protect bees, people, and the planet. [**Will you join us in this fight before Giving Tuesday ends?**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2156665?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
**Help get bee-killing pesticides out of our food system and protect our planet. Donate $27 immediately and your gift will be MATCHED up to $200,000, but only until midnight TONIGHT!**
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_
[Donate $27 immediately](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2156661?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

[](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2156666?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
We rely on bees and other pollinators for 1 in 3 bites of the food we eat, including the most nutritious -- so when we lose bees, **we also lose some of the foods that keep us healthy!** In fact, the decline in bees and other pollinators has already harmed global fruit, vegetable, and nut production. Without access to these vital crops and a healthy diet, people could be at _**higher risk of heart disease, stroke, diabetes, and even cancer**_ , according to a recent study.
Without action, you and I could be part of the last generation to share the planet with many vital bee species.
At Friends of the Earth, we are doing everything we can to help save pollinators, protect our health, and stop the destruction of our planet. We're working to ban toxic pesticides that are driving the decline of bees and butterflies. At the same time, we're pushing major grocery companies like Kroger to stop selling food grown with these chemicals. With your help and membership support today, we can make a difference.
But the bees are running out of time -- **and they need you.**
If we don't stand up to Big Pesticide corporations now, **we could lose hundreds of wild bee species** in North America alone. It's up to us to help prevent a world without these vulnerable pollinators. Please, Friend, we need you by our side as we ramp up our efforts to save wild bees from extinction and protect our planet.
**Stop the downward spiral of vulnerable pollinator populations and protect our planet. Donate $27 or more to Friends of the Earth today and make DOUBLE the impact in honor of Giving Tuesday!**

[https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif]
Senator Joe Manchin’s announcement to not seek reelection to the U.S. Senate shook up our race in a huge way.
Republicans are now basically guaranteed to flip West Virginia, meaning they’re just one seat away from taking back the Senate majority.
That also means the GOP will have even more resources to pour into our state, so we need to prepare for the fight of our lives.
Wisconsin is already home to some of the most expensive and competitive races in our country, and I’m already one of Mitch McConnell’s top targets to defeat.
The stakes are too high to let the GOP take back our Senate majority and push their dangerous right-wing agenda, so I’m personally asking:
Can I count on you to split a donation between Kirsten Gillibrand and my campaign before our end-of-month deadline? Any amount will go a long way toward helping us defend Wisconsin’s U.S. Senate seat and our Democratic majority. Friend, This Giving Tuesday, I hope you’ll join me in supporting a community-based nonprofit focused on providing residents with the opportunity to revitalize their neighborhoods. **Cody Rouge Community Action Alliance** provides local youth with leadership development and community service opportunities as well as work-readiness training. The group engages Detroit residents of all ages in essential neighborhood development and decision-making, with a focus on keeping residents in their homes, supporting caregivers, and youth programing. Their services include:
* supporting seniors’ physical, mental, and social health
* visiting every occupied residence in 7 defined neighborhoods via in-person, door to door canvassing
* Thanksgiving baskets for 250 homes each year
* entrepreneur training programs
* helping residents with tax exemption grant applications
* assisting people with 0% interest home loan repairs
* and funding for students including school supplies, field trips, and workshops

[**Join me in supporting Cody Rouge Community Action Alliance this Giving Tuesday. Let's support a vital nonprofit organization that is truly rooted in community.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/atcYNHk4Eh2YdGnwBh-YDNNE2doVnExAB3cP7VFlQcPrS7NSLVeOVKDeNpCheb_exZr3rlihfeVJ5ELGQB53Ois79UIaxoCqyejsSBq7lm38PhvUep2aeP5DR6OwB6YnlCUcxDtKrphBfEnsJCNOIglBLKvzfyhlYA7EQ3MHGouMcvHxdHeP7tZYAnwsENQeGi94TcFNBqsN-Dk2thxnwpXPxRsrChvgCVYNy4ymQoJ_I65bkZhtRIBz1HKk3nDNMYvoix5ZQACKxnk9DcbCCjWnZUR28VWhvOMQxUtDXFZoBh2fTMoFj6k3TGqmbTpkhkcSUbGOollckMz7KESNJziqsKK8Vf7Wu7Ea-8NCHIqlt6FbrlS8MzBB39Li20ew/41o/vlOx8zVbRpy1DDK12MzYjA/h1/EybESdDKnD4Dr2Sp0FprInK0gSE9LI--Wd3HELGdaec) | [DONATE TO CODY ROUGE ALLIANCE](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/atcYNHk4Eh2YdGnwBh-YDNNE2doVnExAB3cP7VFlQcPrS7NSLVeOVKDeNpCheb_eZE1QTfsUgI9mBxzgqme75lp9ly1NMyfZOL4ID7fM-8aGWIm165J03WFKIydIsqCYIvNkj5kd0ZeTQyHp2oE6WY1UACRh66Ebrt9j_XKIx504Bc0rdo2ahcTF5-jG2blaS8J_CxJk_Y4a5OZkjDjYzJLba4QjrGyeLzSYmG-eIiBr0PykVToze86plpDCd1jNUDY4_wJE6yGBt4N2Zvcr44poqOcUthIpNeMyoRHxtKqW3WH26p8b_w-iGSMMw9fh1QY3CS46ZJg0lBHNgkxoi6gy9x9forbYZlaXFKgVc9amXKCDUz6Dgs1Vm7AladWB/41o/vlOx8zVbRpy1DDK12MzYjA/h2/lqD7V82vXdkwOZAqClYPpijaTi5v2xcHQD5jbyz21Co)

Dear Friend,
You don't know me yet but my name is Sandy Bishop Maynard, I am the founder and Director of the women's art therapy non profit, Beautifully Broken. Since it’s **_Giving Tuesday_** , I’m writing to tell you about what we do and all the women we've helped over the last seven years. About fifteen years ago, I invited a group of women to my house for a knitting circle. We met once a month, and as time went on, we began to share our stories. We cried and we laughed, it was our ladies night. I began to dream of a place where I could invite these women to be able to get away from their world as they knew it. I wanted to provide a way for them to be away from the dirt in their lives, for an hour or a day; a sanctuary away from hurt, fear, the media; a place where their minds could rest enough to be able to express their emotions by using art as a therapeutic avenue for healing. With support from great people in my life, Beautifully Broken was birthed. Since 2016 we have embedded ourselves in halfway houses, women's shelters, and women's correctional facilities, to offer the women within them the opportunity to heal through art.
---
| [ ](https://url1005.email.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTNAbu_nwMZMMBbKVuQ44FfAht9NfoBofTXFMjWEFRrO_8Quf4UqX4GWOvmCyUm7Q6qKioxvr9zpszGjjwnGlkP7cei98QA8BlbDfIQbwJziL5whMI_idGUD_Fu93FRcKza1mUi6UJ8oGIwUwLQ_vmDho-UhZYSeAqos9Ijh94iumUu5Bx7Kq7Fhn8jNq0TfaUfyt7vqBVm1UCbOCjfEF81JzmwoStzbnLZc2lL4oEHTWJ6n4KjtUhNEJU6lFkxJTo8npWBiBORg-xEb8sj5z_tQTzPVf6lm9jKRI3HyrOC9Z/41o/ofilImkHRvGaz0GfmpZDlw/h1/PEB50HaH-rRFIzUCmuGsTfDJjWuDI7DaIu4VyJ6gfCc)
---
_A few of the thousands of women whose lives were touched by art in 2023 with the help of Beautifully Broken._
---
We focus on women who are hurting and heavy with their circumstances; women who have been through the kind of trauma that we don’t like to talk about ... the stuff we find hidden under the household “rug” or in the “closet”. Each one of us could reach back through the haze of secrecy and shame, and remember someone in our own circles who has been through trauma and pain. The circumstances vary, of course. Abuse, whether emotional or physical; rejection in every aspect of life’s relationships, from the very first time we hopped out of our cocoon to face this world. It's my hope these women feel they have a safe place to come to, without the dirt of their world, or even the dust. I want them to find a new kind of magical “dust”, to enable them to not only pick their heads up, but to open their wings and fly! We show these women that in their brokenness, they are beautiful individuals, who, because of their brokenness, can in turn help other women who are broken. **Since 2016 we have provided tens of thousands of women with art therapy that’s fostered growth and healing.** We’ve set up groups at dozens of halfway houses, gone into prisons to teach art to incarcerated women, opened up our own studio, and have partnered with reentry organizations like the **Women’s Bean Project,** **Second Chance Center** , and **The Empowerment Program** to provide our services to marginalized and formerly incarcerated women returning to the workforce. The COVID-19 pandemic hit us hard preventing us from entering prisons, and forcing many of the facilities we had been working with to close their doors, thereby depriving us of the revenue we needed to keep our studio open. But we’ve come a long way since then, we have up a giant new studio space, re-launched our partnerships with organizations who had to pause our services due to pandemic social distancing like The Empowerment Program, and have been steadily growing the attendance of our weekly art therapy sessions. [**We need to keep growing, and since it’s Giving Tuesday I’m writing to ask if you would help us by chipping in $25, or whatever you can spare, to fund this vital work we are doing here at Beautifully Broken?**](https://url1005.email.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTNAbu_nwMZMMBbKVuQ44FfAht9NfoBofTXFMjWEFRrO_8Quf4UqX4GWOvmCyUm7Q6joVk1aMJCt39GFlaHN62pGncF8JJni2wAu4yxJ0xosxh-iRqH6jRBv5WldLW9ekhHzVl_lFCNw-Zv3S_Gs9H-mN1nWLZ7QYtX2yBuj6jTngR4FY1Xbc6CB3pz3O0L0DUjGX5nNWbps3kDin-GAJ2HCH0XYCXyqTHb5FPQTLdsRurfgSgJG3lyyYWgpkY7ZnSTHFex7qZu8PpYDZWwUsu94bqGSwpvpAe1GSNLQt79t8/41o/ofilImkHRvGaz0GfmpZDlw/h2/Blm_Z35IYrmeFFHGQo3w2Kdnz7SIAX-ArgbYtN-kLSA)

When I launched my campaign for president, I was seen as an underdog. I was underestimated time and time again - **but now, the tide is turning.**

I surged to be tied for _**SECOND**_ in Iowa.

I am **CRUSHING** Joe Biden in the national polls.

_We are**RISING** to the top, and it's all thanks to people like you who have stepped up and supported my campaign._

While this is all great news, we've got to continue to keep our heads down, work hard, and earn every vote in order to win.

That's why I need your help today.**[Will you chip in $20.24 right now to help me fund my campaign and spread my message far and wide?](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/Rg9-pldSHBqOp3PMvO42Uw~~/AARclAA~~ "Will you chip in $20.24 right now to help me fund my campaign and spread my message far and wide?")**

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

body:
__This will only take a moment |
---

| **Peter -- earlier, we shared the news that for Giving Tuesday, a major donor had pledged to contribute a $100,000 gift to LCV. **

**There 's a catch. We only get this gift IF -- and only IF -- 1,000 supporters like you also pitch in by midnight tonight.**

As things stand, we are still 358 donations short of reaching that goal.

This is an important one: **What we raise today will have SUCH a big impact on the environmental campaigns we can run going into the new year, that we 're asking everyone to pitch in:**

[Renew your LCV membership in honor of Giving Tuesday and help unlock $100,000 more to fund our critical work >>](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/yAyZM-_)

_**This is a big goal to reach -- but if you start a monthly donation -- even if it's just $5 -- we get to count it 12 times. I hope we'll hear from you today!**_ |

* * *

---

|
Peter -- Today is Giving Tuesday, the global day of generosity to support the causes you care about most. And as an LCV supporter, I know that, for you, ensuring a healthy, safe, and just world for current and future generations is a top priority.

That's why I'm hoping you'll join our Giving Tuesday challenge now: **A donor has pledged to contribute an additional $100,000 Giving Tuesday gift to LCV to fund our work into 2024, IF -- and only IF -- 1,000 supporters make a Giving Tuesday donation to LCV by midnight tonight.**

[Renew your LCV membership in honor of Giving Tuesday and help unlock $100,000 more to fund our critical work >>](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/yAyZM-_)

_(If you 're able to start a monthly donation -- even if it's just $5 -- we get to count it 12 times. This will have such a huge impact on the campaigns we can run going into the new year, so we're asking everyone to pitch in what they can.)_

| | **
** **FOR IMMEDIATE REVIEW**

**Supporter Record:** Peter Willis
**Email:** dpwillis67@gmail.com

**GOAL:** 1,000 donations by midnight tonight
**PROGRESS:** 64% to goal

**STATUS:** [Renew now -- it only takes $5 >>](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/yAyZM-_) |
---|---|---

With your help, I know that LCV can continue to make meaningful progress towards protecting our communities and our planet for generations to come.

Here are just a few reasons why your Giving Tuesday gift is EXTRA important right now:
1. **Because Republicans are _still_ threatening to shut down our government unless they get massive cuts to environmental programs.** We just narrowly avoided a government shutdown, but the next funding deadline is right around the corner, and every environmental legislative attack the MAGA fringe has passed in recent weeks is still on the table: We _have_ to make sure all of our progress doesn't end up on the chopping block now. [We're counting on your support to defend the environment in Congress. Pitch in now >>](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/yAyZM-_)
2. **Because we can get closer to our goal of protecting 30 percent of U.S. lands and waters by 2030 with more monument designations.** President Biden has already taken action to protect cultural and sacred sites for Indigenous people and landscapes rich in ecological and historical value in Nevada and Arizona, accessible plateaus and ridges in Texas, landmarks honoring the fight for racial justice and snow-capped peaks in Colorado, among others. Now there are even more opportunities to protect more lands and culturally significant sites for people rather than for logging and fossil fuel industries -- and we need people like you on our side. [We can win these fights, but only if the environmental movement shows up >>](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/yAyZM-_)
3. **Because we have the chance to shut down the Dakota Access Oil Pipeline once and for all.** For years, the Standing Rock Sioux Tribe has led the fight against the dirty Pipeline, which threatens clean drinking water for millions of people. Now, the Army Corps of Engineers has been ordered by the courts to conduct a new environmental impact analysis and take public comment as a result of the Tribe's steadfast opposition. [This is our best-ever opportunity to shut down this project -- and your support can help make that happen. Donate today >>](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/yAyZM-_)
4. **Because a group of donors has offered $100,000 in matching gift funds.** Bottom line: Your contribution goes further to win environmental campaigns that matter if you give now and help unlock this critical funding. [Renew your LCV membership for $5 today >>](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/yAyZM-_)

**Meeting our Giving Tuesday goal matters.** I hope you'll pitch in: Our match unlock goal is 1,000 donors, but it ends at midnight tonight. [Renew your membership now. Even $5 can have a huge impact >>](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/yAyZM-_)

Thank you for your support of LCV's work!

Onward,

Gene Karpinski
President
League of Conservation Voters
__
__

| | Peter — **Each of us is thankful for Oregon in our own, unique ways. It's our home, through and through, and we're all a little different, a little better for making our lives here.** One thing I'm specifically thankful for is Oregon's unrivaled natural beauty, which is a promise handed down to us by everyone who came before — and our **tremendous responsibility** to protect for those who will come after we're gone. Now that we're back on the campaign trail after recharging with family and loved ones, it's my responsibility to speak truth to power: **our incumbent member of Congress, Lori Chavez-DeRemer, is cozying up to a lot of entrenched incumbents and special interests who have**** _abysmal_****records on protecting the environment.**
* Chavez-DeRemer's choice to lead the Republican Party, _her_ party, in the House? Louisiana's Mike Johnson, who **denies climate science** at every opportunity and is all-in with big polluters, whose deep pockets fund his campaign more than any other industry.1
* Chavez-DeRemer has done a big media circuit about joining a _conservative_ climate caucus, but it seems like a lot of PR. The group's leader, Utah Republican John Curtis, has a lifetime score of 7% from the League of Conservation Voters, and has previously introduced legislation to**fast-track oil drilling** on federal lands.2
* In her 2022 campaign, Chavez-DeRemer gladly took big bucks from **Koch Industries** , which has been at the forefront of climate denial and extreme anti-environment politics for a generation.3

As has been said, _tell me who your friends are, and I'll show you who you are._ **I am running for Congress because the people of Oregon deserve an honest, earnest voice to protect the environment and address climate change**. That won't happen as long as Republicans are in control of the House, with Lori Chavez-DeRemer cozying up to all kinds of anti-environment, anti-climate science politicians. It's our home, through and through, and we're all a little different, a little better for making our lives here. One thing I'm specifically thankful for is Oregon's unrivaled natural beauty, which is a promise handed down to us by everyone who came before — and our tremendous responsibility to protect for those who will come after we're gone. Now that we're back on the campaign trail after recharging with family and loved ones, it's my responsibility to speak truth to power: our incumbent member of Congress, Lori Chavez-DeRemer, is cozying up to a lot of entrenched incumbents and special interests who have abysmalrecords on protecting the environment. Chavez-DeRemer's choice to lead the Republican Party, her party, in the House? Louisiana's Mike Johnson, who denies climate science at every opportunity and is all-in with big polluters, whose deep pockets fund his campaign more than any other industry.1 Chavez-DeRemer has done a big media circuit about joining a conservative climate caucus, but it seems like a lot of PR. The group's leader, Utah Republican John Curtis, has a lifetime score of 7% from the League of Conservation Voters, and has previously introduced legislation tofast-track oil drilling on federal lands.2 In her 2022 campaign, Chavez-DeRemer gladly took big bucks from Koch Industries , which has been at the forefront of climate denial and extreme anti-environment politics for a generation.3 As has been said, tell me who your friends are, and I'll show you who you are. I am running for Congress because the people of Oregon deserve an honest, earnest voice to protect the environment and address climate change. Glimpses of each week on the road to the White House

| [ ](https://www.kennedy24.com/?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=notes_from_the_trail_unopen_3&n=1)
---
* * *
# Notes from the Campaign Trail
Edition #1 from Campaign Director, Amaryllis Kennedy
* * *
* * *
Peter -- Back when I was a college kid studying in England, I fell in love with a radio broadcast called "Letters from America," narrated by Alistair Cooke. Stories of everyday existence back in my beloved country made me feel less alone, somehow, in my wistfulness for America, my devotion to all that she is, and my hope for all that she might yet become. In these last weeks since taking the helm of this campaign, I've come to recognize that same sense of homesickness in our movement. Only the home we all long for is a future America -- one of health and wealth, of fellowship and freedom, of truthfulness and promise. We all know that this home exists just as surely as I knew mine lay across the proverbial pond, back when I was a lonely student in that chilly, British dorm. And so I figured that perhaps we should take a lesson from that old radio broadcast and share some weekly letters from across our national movement, to keep us all connected as, together, we walk home. This first note is going to be a long one, so make a cup of tea and settle in... There's much exciting progress to report -- ballot access plans and poll numbers, grassroots events and media awakenings, finance committees and mobile apps to fuel the historic work ahead. But before I get into all that, on this thanksgiving weekend, I want to start with the prayers. Almost every day, sometimes several times a day, one of you writes to tell me that you are praying for Bobby, praying for our campaign, praying for our country. These notes mean more to me than I could ever say. I believe that Bobby was prepared by Providence for this moment and that every one of us, in our small way, has also been led through a series of lessons and experiences in this life that have equipped us with the unique fingerprint of insights and skills that we each need to play our supporting roles in the forces of light. Back in those undergrad Oxford days, I served as the sacristan of my college, Pembroke, and prepared communion in our beautiful chapel each Sunday morning, as many of my friends slept off their late Saturday nights. I was often a little groggy myself, truth be told, but there was something profound about that quiet morning crispness as I walked across Christ Church Meadows, where Tolkien is said to have opened C.S. Lewis' mind to the existence of a higher power on an overnight stroll. The early sun would begin to clear the mist from the river as I made my way toward the dreaming spires of town, punctuated just as I arrived by dozens of hand-rung church bells from each of the colleges, beginning moments apart, like the singing rounds my grandma used to lead us in as kids. I have the same sense of breaking dawn about this moment. Bobby is leading us into the sun and the daylight is burning off the mists. It reminds me of wise old Ben Franklin’s quote at the end of the Constitutional Convention. Having mulled the half-sun carved on the back of George Washington’s chair all those hot, muggy Philadelphia months, he said as the last signature was added to our highest law, “I see now that it is a rising and not a setting sun.” For the first time in my lifetime, Bobby is proving Ben Franklin right. And it is the highest privilege (and heaviest responsibility) I have ever known to lead this campaign beneath him. I do so as the steward of every American who yearns for the country they know lies just beyond the darkness of corruption and the mists of government lies. The country of our hearts. Each of you has been prepared for your role here, just as I have. Looking back on your life's experiences, you may notice that you have seen and done things that make you uniquely qualified for your particular work supporting this campaign. A connecting of the dots. Seemingly random opportunities seized or challenges overcome or career moves made that now, years later, make sense as a sort of curriculum that delivered you to this very moment. Take my life, for example. Three unusual professional phases that each taught me core lessons I needed for this work. First, my years at CIA, born of the desire to talk with our adversaries face-to-face, to understand them as humans rather than media cartoons, to see if maybe there wasn't some different path to peace. I joined after 9/11, fresh on the heels of my twin degrees in international law and theology, trying to make sense of the goodness of people in the context of such violence and pain. The Agency was pitched to me as a secret version of the diplomatic service, building relationships with those adversaries too hostile for normal embassies and black-tie parties. I hadn't yet read The Devil's Chessboard or researched the full extent of our nation's egregious intelligence crimes, but I knew that daylight was the best disinfectant and I pressed back in my interviews on the potential for abuse when work is undertaken in the shadows. "Oh, but the Church Commission!" I was assured and, naively perhaps, I reasoned that the best way to guard against future abuses was for good people to flood out the bad. Talking with enemies beats bombing them, after all, and I felt sure that my moral true north would keep the darkness at bay. What I didn't yet know, in those young years, is that corrupt structures are designed to isolate lone lanterns in the basement -- that only a removal of the roof up top can truly flood the entire house with light. Almost as soon as they hired me, I began flagging potential crimes and sending complaints up the command chain, making myself such a thorn in the side of the corrupt seventh floor that they shipped me out to the field in isolation, exiled from Agency offices and charged with safe-guarding those adversaries who put their own lives on the line to offer warnings before bombings that they privately feared would take too many civilian lives. Side-lined though I was, I don't regret the years I spent in that service. It gave me a lifelong understanding of the humanity of our enemies, to eat in their homes and play with their children. My job was never to lie to them -- they knew who I worked for and that by sharing information with me, they were preventing this or that attack. Many of them had gotten themselves into something they had first believed was righteous and now wanted a way out. Wanted to preserve life instead of taking it. Often, I sensed that we were all just trying to escape the same darkness above us, the leaders on all sides of that endless war -- and every war -- who profit from the violence that tears the rest of us apart. When word of the CIA's abhorrent torture program began to emerge, I knew my little lantern in the proverbial basement wasn't making any difference and I left in disgust. I took with me an unshakable devotion to ending the imperialistic impulses that I had seen claim so many innocent lives, to dismantling the heinous tentacles of our security services, and to lifting the shroud of secrecy that hides these abuses from the tax-payers who fund them. For six years after that, I learned a different set of skills that I would some day need for this campaign -- this time in the realm of business and tech. Unable to share my first-hand criticisms of the forever wars until my cover had been rolled back, I looked for another way to help make a difference while I waited. A friend of mine was blogging back then and explained that she paid her bills with affiliate links -- the small commissions she received when a reader clicked on one of her product links to make a purchase. That seemed like a lot of spare change rolling around the internet that could add up to something good. So I hooked up with an engineering pal and built a little startup that used natural language processing to identify product mentions and make them shoppable, with the proceeds benefitting the charity of the readers' choice. Born in a literal garage, our baby technology ended up being used by big publishers like Hearst and Conde Nast. We took venture funding, built a team of several dozen and raised over a million dollars for soup kitchens and animal rescue groups, hurricane relief and just about every other community cause you can imagine. I never liked the tech world very much, but it taught me an enormous amount about managing organizations and leveraging nationwide networks to do some real good. I took those skills to Twitter, where I ran product for their Consumer Commerce Division with an even bigger team, and got a first-hand look at the power and peril of Silicon Valley giants run amok. Finally, in 2015, word came from on high that my old cover had been rolled back. My third professional chapter taught me the most, perhaps, in preparation for this campaign. It began the moment I could talk about all that I'd seen: the horrors of war and the Washington corruption that drives them. I left the tech world behind me and sat down to write a book. It talked about how young people get dragged into the illusion of battle in their blind desire to do something righteous. It talked about how if we stop to listen to our adversaries, we'll find that they are ensnared in the very same trap. It talked about the corruption of our leaders and the profits that fuel the whole murderous system. And when I published it, the government went on the offense. They flooded the media with attacks and the Amazon reviews with trolls, just like they'd warned me they would. They even surveilled my emails, as I discovered from an anodyne notification that Google sent me three years after they had stopped. But truth, as we know in this campaign, resonates at a different frequency from propaganda. Readers around the world reached out to tell me how my message of dialogue moved them, how they too felt it was time to dismantle the security state and break free of our leaders' endless cycles of war. God cleared the way, then, for speaking truth to power. I made a Netflix series about the US Government's militarization of the developing world. I wrote about the role of the spooks in the assassinations of the 60s. I investigated Lockerbie and Iran Contra and tied them together -- the perfect example of blowback, when our country's crimes contribute to costing our citizens their lives. I spoke all over the nation about a different path, a more human way forward. Eventually, I keynoted the midterm Libertarian convention, calling for an end to our war machine the same week I got married in 2018. And the man I married turned out to have a father who was fighting for these same things as well. My mother says that coincidences are God talking. I hear those stories of synchronicity every day on this campaign. In my case, the synchronicities began with this winding road I've just described, a path guided by instinct and grace, equipping me with just the right quiver of arrows to play my small role in this revolution of peace. From CIA, I received my detailed knowledge of the corrupt forces we come to vanquish and the human suffering that will continue to result if we fail. From those days in business and tech, I received my gifts at building nationwide networks of people and organizing millions of small actions into large-scale impacts. And from my years publicly challenging our national warmongers, I received my rock-solid conviction that the lies of a corrupt few will never silence opposition voiced by the righteous rest. Truthfully, when Bobby asked me to take over leadership of his campaign, every selfish part of me wanted to stay firmly planted in the wings. I'd been co-managing our efforts since the beginning and I felt confidant about the tasks ahead, vast and vital as they were. But I knew that official leadership would bring with it all sorts of other psychic assaults -- the media attacks and opposition smears that come with any visible role in the battle against tyranny. I have three cubs and worried about the effect on them. And I knew, too, that many in our movement would feel anxious about turning over the reigns to a person who once worked at the very agency that has stamped out so many lives, encroached on so many liberties, and played what I believe to be an incontrovertible role in the assassinations of Bobby's uncle and father. As I have shared on social media, I deeply understand and appreciate this fear. If I didn’t know me, I would have it too. But alongside that understanding is my certainty that the only solution is for us to run a winning campaign, so that a Kennedy Administration can finally bring an end to the very abuses and lies that rightfully make our community suspicious of government sabotage in this and all peaceful movements for change. As counterintuitive as it may seem, many of the fiercest activists for ending our military imperialism and the hideous crimes of our intelligence apparatus are military and IC veterans who witnessed abuses while serving. Dan Ellsberg. Ed Snowden. Chelsea Manning. Ray McGovern. The presidents who have warned us most presciently about the dangers of the defense industrial complex and the CIA — Ike and JFK — were themselves both veterans. General Smedley Butler, who foiled the Wall Street Bankers’ Coup to overthrow our government in 1933, was a three-decade veteran of the Marine Corps and forward-deployed arm of the CIA’s horrors in Latin America. This experience allowed him to speak truth to power and safeguard our republic against the very forces that he had once served. I attach his remarks below, as true today as they were then, and I draw inspiration from those before me, who have metabolized the crimes they witnessed into an indefatigable drive to rid our nation of such mortal dangers and set us back on the path to freedom, transparency, and peace. Their example helped guide me, when Bobby asked me to take over. I would guess that, one time or another, many of you have found yourselves faced with a similar quandary. Do I speak out for the truth? Do I put my head above the parapet? Or do I protect myself against the attacks that such vulnerability may unleash in the hopes that someone equally qualified will do it in my place? But the thing is -- there is nobody equally qualified as you. Each of you, like me, has lead a life of unique lessons. And each of you is irreplaceable in this fight. As I was reminded recently by a wise man, the book of Esther asks us: "Who knows if perhaps you were made for just such a time as this?" I believe that you were. I believe that I was. Above all, I believe that Bobby was. And so I said yes. On this thanksgiving weekend, and on every future day of our journey, I hope that you will ask yourself the same question that Mordecai asked Esther. And I hope that you, too, will say yes. Yes to hosting gatherings. Yes to wearing your Kennedy shirts. Yes to giving of your time and resources. Yes to showing up. Yes to whatever your heart is guiding you to do right now. Because that is how we stay in our magnificent power. That is how we link arms, across cities and pastures and mountains. That is how, together and at last, we prove Ben Franklin right. In the oncoming warmth of that rising sun, I send you each my love and respect. Until next week, Amaryllis Team Kennedy

I took with me an unshakable devotion to ending the imperialistic impulses that I had seen claim so many innocent lives, to dismantling the heinous tentacles of our security services, and to lifting the shroud of secrecy that hides these abuses from the tax-payers who fund them. For six years after that, I learned a different set of skills that I would some day need for this campaign -- this time in the realm of business and tech. Unable to share my first-hand criticisms of the forever wars until my cover had been rolled back, I looked for another way to help make a difference while I waited. A friend of mine was blogging back then and explained that she paid her bills with affiliate links -- the small commissions she received when a reader clicked on one of her product links to make a purchase. That seemed like a lot of spare change rolling around the internet that could add up to something good. So I hooked up with an engineering pal and built a little startup that used natural language processing to identify product mentions and make them shoppable, with the proceeds benefitting the charity of the readers' choice. Born in a literal garage, our baby technology ended up being used by big publishers like Hearst and Conde Nast. We took venture funding, built a team of several dozen and raised over a million dollars for soup kitchens and animal rescue groups, hurricane relief and just about every other community cause you can imagine. I never liked the tech world very much, but it taught me an enormous amount about managing organizations and leveraging nationwide networks to do some real good. I took those skills to Twitter, where I ran product for their Consumer Commerce Division with an even bigger team, and got a first-hand look at the power and peril of Silicon Valley giants run amok. Finally, in 2015, word came from on high that my old cover had been rolled back. My third professional chapter taught me the most, perhaps, in preparation for this campaign. It began the moment I could talk about all that I'd seen: the horrors of war and the Washington corruption that drives them. I left the tech world behind me and sat down to write a book. It talked about how young people get dragged into the illusion of battle in their blind desire to do something righteous. It talked about how if we stop to listen to our adversaries, we'll find that they are ensnared in the very same trap. It talked about the corruption of our leaders and the profits that fuel the whole murderous system. And when I published it, the government went on the offense. They flooded the media with attacks and the Amazon reviews with trolls, just like they'd warned me they would. They even surveilled my emails, as I discovered from an anodyne notification that Google sent me three years after they had stopped. But truth, as we know in this campaign, resonates at a different frequency from propaganda. Readers around the world reached out to tell me how my message of dialogue moved them, how they too felt it was time to dismantle the security state and break free of our leaders' endless cycles of war. God cleared the way, then, for speaking truth to power. I made a Netflix series about the US Government's militarization of the developing world. I wrote about the role of the spooks in the assassinations of the 60s. I investigated Lockerbie and Iran Contra and tied them together -- the perfect example of blowback, when our country's crimes contribute to costing our citizens their lives. I spoke all over the nation about a different path, a more human way forward. Eventually, I keynoted the midterm Libertarian convention, calling for an end to our war machine the same week I got married in 2018. And the man I married turned out to have a father who was fighting for these same things as well. My mother says that coincidences are God talking. I hear those stories of synchronicity every day on this campaign. In my case, the synchronicities began with this winding road I've just described, a path guided by instinct and grace, equipping me with just the right quiver of arrows to play my small role in this revolution of peace. From CIA, I received my detailed knowledge of the corrupt forces we come to vanquish and the human suffering that will continue to result if we fail. From those days in business and tech, I received my gifts at building nationwide networks of people and organizing millions of small actions into large-scale impacts. And from my years publicly challenging our national warmongers, I received my rock-solid conviction that the lies of a corrupt few will never silence opposition voiced by the righteous rest. Truthfully, when Bobby asked me to take over leadership of his campaign, every selfish part of me wanted to stay firmly planted in the wings. I'd been co-managing our efforts since the beginning and I felt confidant about the tasks ahead, vast and vital as they were. But I knew that official leadership would bring with it all sorts of other psychic assaults -- the media attacks and opposition smears that come with any visible role in the battle against tyranny. I have three cubs and worried about the effect on them. And I knew, too, that many in our movement would feel anxious about turning over the reigns to a person who once worked at the very agency that has stamped out so many lives, encroached on so many liberties, and played what I believe to be an incontrovertible role in the assassinations of Bobby's uncle and father. As I have shared on social media, I deeply understand and appreciate this fear. If I didn’t know me, I would have it too. But alongside that understanding is my certainty that the only solution is for us to run a winning campaign, so that a Kennedy Administration can finally bring an end to the very abuses and lies that rightfully make our community suspicious of government sabotage in this and all peaceful movements for change. As counterintuitive as it may seem, many of the fiercest activists for ending our military imperialism and the hideous crimes of our intelligence apparatus are military and IC veterans who witnessed abuses while serving. Dan Ellsberg. Ed Snowden. Chelsea Manning. Ray McGovern. The presidents who have warned us most presciently about the dangers of the defense industrial complex and the CIA — Ike and JFK — were themselves both veterans. General Smedley Butler, who foiled the Wall Street Bankers’ Coup to overthrow our government in 1933, was a three-decade veteran of the Marine Corps and forward-deployed arm of the CIA’s horrors in Latin America. This experience allowed him to speak truth to power and safeguard our republic against the very forces that he had once served. I attach his remarks below, as true today as they were then, and I draw inspiration from those before me, who have metabolized the crimes they witnessed into an indefatigable drive to rid our nation of such mortal dangers and set us back on the path to freedom, transparency, and peace. Their example helped guide me, when Bobby asked me to take over. I would guess that, one time or another, many of you have found yourselves faced with a similar quandary. Do I speak out for the truth? Do I put my head above the parapet? Or do I protect myself against the attacks that such vulnerability may unleash in the hopes that someone equally qualified will do it in my place? But the thing is -- there is nobody equally qualified as you. Each of you, like me, has lead a life of unique lessons. And each of you is irreplaceable in this fight. As I was reminded recently by a wise man, the book of Esther asks us: "Who knows if perhaps you were made for just such a time as this?" I believe that you were. I believe that I was. Above all, I believe that Bobby was. And so I said yes. On this thanksgiving weekend, and on every future day of our journey, I hope that you will ask yourself the same question that Mordecai asked Esther. And I hope that you, too, will say yes. Yes to hosting gatherings. Yes to wearing your Kennedy shirts. Yes to giving of your time and resources. Yes to showing up. Yes to whatever your heart is guiding you to do right now. Because that is how we stay in our magnificent power. That is how we link arms, across cities and pastures and mountains. That is how, together and at last, we prove Ben Franklin right. In the oncoming warmth of that rising sun, I send you each my love and respect. Until next week, Amaryllis Team Kennedy to put a Kennedy back in the White House — Elect Robert F. Kennedy, Jr. as President to unite America in 2024! Make sure to join us on Social Media to help spread our campaign's message and put Robert F. Kennedy, Jr. in the White House! # Baseless CRINGE from Biden Harris HQ and a Democratic internet FUMBLE...

We’ve got a lot of work cut out for us in 2024. It’s a critical election year with several open statewide offices, and we’ll be holding those who participated in the Republican walkout accountable. There’s unfinished business from this year’s legislative session that will be back in the 2024 short session, including threats to our land use system. **But at the forefront of my responsibilities, I am a public servant.**

I work for you, _I serve your interests,_ not the interests of the establishment, lobbyists, or anyone else.

**_I work for the American people._**

body:
We’re launching a fundraiser for three organizations building a better world for working families this year.
#
For Giving Tuesday, we’re launching a fundraiser for three organizations working to transform their communities with programming for youth, affordable housing, migrant services, environmental resilience, and so much more.
[Will you contribute $5 or whatever you can this Giving Tuesday to help these incredible organizers build power for working class people?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20231128-gt.xKmIDX&refcode=em20231128-5390-P_FND_CHA_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5390%2E2526796%2EvdRt61)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20231128-gt.xKmIDX&refcode=em20231128-5390-P_FND_CHA_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=5390%2E2526796%2EvdRt61)**
**[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20231128-gt.xKmIDX&refcode=em20231128-5390-P_FND_CHA_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=5390%2E2526796%2EvdRt61)**
100% of your donation will go to community organizations building a better world for working families across NYC.
Here’s a bit more about the groups you’re supporting:
• **Malikah is a grassroots anti-violence and wellness organization** advocating against gender- and hate-based violence. They provide self-defense training, support economic empowerment, and organize communities to improve public safety. Malikah partners with community organizations, public schools and religious institutions to work with women and girls — and provide support to migrant families — across all five boroughs in NYC.
• **Community Action for Safe Apartments (CASA) is a tenant organizing project** working to protect and maintain affordable and safe housing in The Bronx. CASA organizes tenant associations, provides monthly tenants’ rights workshops and legal clinics, holds community building and leadership development programs, and is involved in city and state-wide housing policy campaigns.
• **The Point Community Development Corporation is dedicated to youth development** and the cultural and economic revitalization of the Hunts Point neighborhood of The Bronx. Celebrating over 25 years of service, The Point provides after-school and summer programming for youth and is working toward the comprehensive revitalization of the area with arts and culture events for the public — like bomba dance classes — and community partnerships to develop environmental justice awareness in Hunts Point.
We’ve seen this movement step up to achieve incredible things before.
**Together, we’ve raised hundreds of thousands of dollars _just this year_ for mutual aid groups, relief efforts, and progressive allies.** Today, we need your help to support more community organizers in our movement for a better world.
[If you are able, please chip in $5 — or whatever you can afford — and your donation will be automatically split between these grassroots organizations to expand their critical work.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20231128-gt.xKmIDX&refcode=em20231128-5390-P_FND_CHA_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=5390%2E2526796%2EvdRt61)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20231128-gt.xKmIDX&refcode=em20231128-5390-P_FND_CHA_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=23&akid=5390%2E2526796%2EvdRt61)**
We are wishing you and your loved ones a happy holiday season.
Yours in community,
Team AOC

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20231128-gt?refcode=em20231128-5390-P_FND_CHA_GRM&t=24&refcode2=5390_2526796_vdRt61&akid=5390%2E2526796%2EvdRt61)** | **[Merch](https://shop.ocasiocortez.com/?utm_source=em-footer-20231128-5390-P_FND_CHA_GRM&t=25&akid=5390%2E2526796%2EvdRt61)**

name: David Horowitz
subject: I’m not saying this to scare you
body:
America is on the brink of destruction.

| |
---
| | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don't say this to shock or scare you - I say it because it's true. _What we see today didn 't happen overnight. It's the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **... and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I'd know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ - radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my "comrades" made possible. So I left and never looked back. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan - then I started the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left and I've dedicated the last 40 years to exposing them. Why? Because I knew first-hand the threat our country was facing. I knew what was at stake and I knew if I didn't tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever. That's why I spent 6 months writing** _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_** - and I want you to have your very own copy of it. **[So I'm asking you to stand with me and make a generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to my Freedom Center. As a thank you, I'll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within.](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=800da9c7fde7466992f67decce0eb975&_e=lmO7ExjZVI_LtJq6Ot9nkk9ra92Aqs0kyUKcb6-q1b9btas91m5XfJDD9qJcdMdQ-LjdYPv9i4U4e1c7c-iqELeu8EspiiYXyOaQ0BK7YXSlonbp_xxvtSLOS5bZM7e1Ki7aPoRj3ysJ9ZxauFWVqDi00RWxKs_d64mVaJHgr6v6fhkqllGNwporwdlIiAxuvXmSDd-dLHJhWoP5RdvkthfwTOdWO6pPtrBBlcIy0O-cV94CYr9Dn2YpLx8cmOMJcA5vwbUeDuyPKpAvvbaxQYawyVM8Q0KyqQ2OhmmgQcO_jmgsrqsi3BoNzqHIdXkjyLHszKQsfX9Yyw31s0BUGl5Se5pU8uw3_1aoZdsIt81bxq_CogxkW3Rs0UX2k31jOVZZbhyqvETa-_hXS8-FfA%3D%3D)** When you think of "the enemy within" you may think of Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi or even Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez...and you wouldn't be wrong. But make no mistake: **The real mastermind is Barack Obama.** Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we've seen since 2020 back in 2008. Barack Obama led the destruction of our cities, cozying up to Black Lives Matter radicals and siding with criminals over police upholding the rule of law. Barack Obama championed the castration of our military, making us a laughingstock on the world stage. And Barack Obama was the true architect behind the bogus Russian collusion witch hunt. The devastation and destruction we see today has been over a decade in the making - but most of the American people have no clue what we're up against. **That 's why I wrote _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_ to explain how communist and fascist Leftists infiltrated and overtook the Democrat Party...** ...how it has become a party of racism and hatred attacking the very foundations of our country... ... and how their ultimate goal is to create a one-party state - and cancel, deplatform and silence every last one of their political opponents by slandering them as "white supremacists" and worse. The reviews speak for themselves... "A Great Book" - Dinesh D'Souza "_The Enemy Within_ is a book for all patriots who understand that our country is in a fight for its life." - Mark Levin "David Horowitz does it again in a must-read for any American concerned about where we are headed as a nation." Laura Ingraham I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because... I know if our country stands a chance, Americans must understand exactly how sinister and dangerous the new Democrat Party actually is. I was the enemy within -- and I know in my bones what it will take to defeat them. We've reached the point in our history that will decide our future - and we either win these political battles or lose everything that makes us prosperous and free. **[That's why I'll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within when you donate $35 or more to the Freedom Center today and give us the ammunition we need to expose the Left's evil agenda to every American patriot.](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=800da9c7fde7466992f67decce0eb975&_e=lmO7ExjZVI_LtJq6Ot9nkk9ra92Aqs0kyUKcb6-q1b9btas91m5XfJDD9qJcdMdQ-LjdYPv9i4U4e1c7c-iqELeu8EspiiYXyOaQ0BK7YXSlonbp_xxvtSLOS5bZM7e1Ki7aPoRj3ysJ9ZxauFWVqDi00RWxKs_d64mVaJHgr6v6fhkqllGNwporwdlIiAxuvXmSDd-dLHJhWoP5RdvkthfwTOdWO6pPtrBBlcIy0O-cV94CYr9Dn2YpLx8cmOMJXlDd-Oi4n9UgK6NTlV2NB25PdEGZDNvH2x-zS_Npt1TOP6pHvHGdD9FEjp_DJ1A3ojmi-hXeYFE20dmCbL8yY96H57_PYzIPJKWVw-EeIEXFtpy9xiL6DShT1B-6_1Yx7vBLsZADwEJPhxF1Fh50IA%3D%3D)** The Left is at war with America. They don't simply disagree with us about how to make our country better - they want to destroy it to make way for their Marxist dystopia. Or in Obama's own words "radically transform" America. **And they don 't care how much they have to lie, cheat or steal to achieve it.** So it's up to patriots like you and me to expose the truth about the Left to our fellow Americans while we still can.

David Horowitz

**The Truth About The Coming Food Crisis** **This might be your only warning.** According to official reports, dangerous global events have reached America, putting the entire nation in harm's way. Despite this imminent crisis, mainstream media remains silent... Then, when they finally elected a Speaker, they picked one of the most despicable far-right Members of their party. **Our new House Speaker Mike Johnson once wrote in favor of criminalizing homosexuality.**

| Dear Friends and Neighbors,

I got invited to the PA Society festivities in New York City this weekend. That’s the annual holiday get-together when Pennsylvania’s political elites meet up in fancy Manhattan ballrooms for three days of networking, politicking, and partying. You probably never heard of it, but you can read all about it [here](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=a5329fa187&e=1090c5c412).

Some of the meetings are useful. Two years ago, I attended a PA Society luncheon about healthcare policy changes and digital currency regulations from subject matter experts. I learned a lot and was grateful for the invitation.

Some of the meetings are not. When I was in my twenties working in Harrisburg, I attended several PA Society receptions that were more parties than policy. They were fun, but I’m glad I grew up and moved on.

It’s too easy to get caught up in the lifestyle of a career politician. Talented people enter the profession but never leave. Some are seeking fame- they want to have their own entourage. Some are seeking power- they want to control other people’s lives. Some just want to make money- politics can be a lucrative business for those who make it their livelihood.

And that’s the problem. When politicians put their careers ahead of their constituents, it warps the way they think and changes the way they behave. Eventually, they start voting for themselves and not for us. That’s how we get multi-trillion-dollar deficits and terrible laws like no-excuse mail-in balloting.

It’s no wonder people are tired of career politicians. I sure am. In fact, my disdain for the self-serving political class almost caused me to quit this race before I even began.

Earlier this year, I went to Washington for some meetings about my candidacy. In one day, it seemed like I met every disgusting political caricature you could imagine- the slimy lobbyist, the drunk staffer, the spin doctor, the elitist snob. When I saw some natty young men getting their shoes shined at the Capitol Hill Club, I had enough. They were acting like characters in a bad episode of the West Wing.

I called my wife Susan and told her I would never fit in here, that I didn’t trust these people, and that I wasn’t cut out for this. I told her I just wanted to come home.

“Don’t you see Kevin,” said Susan. “That’s why you need to do this. Because you’re not one of them.”

She's right. I’m not one of them. I shine my own shoes.

I hope my colleagues have a productive and enjoyable time in New York City at PA Society. I won’t be going. I have military obligations and will be serving with my brothers and sisters in uniform most of the weekend. And that suits me just fine.

**Keep America Free.**

_Kevin Dellicker is a husband and father who has lived in the Lehigh Valley for 40 years. He's the founder of a successful technology company and a 28-year veteran of the U.S. Armed Forces. Kevin's not running for Congress because he needs a job. He's running because he's got the experience, vision, and courage to defend our American way of life. _
