name: Greg Casar
subject: Texas’s abortion ban is in court today
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY GREG CASAR FOR CONGRESS
body:
Peter,
**Today the Texas Supreme Court will begin hearing arguments on the state’s near-total ban on abortions.**
Let me back up. After Roe v. Wade was overturned, Texas Republicans instituted a near-total ban on abortions in Texas—with no exceptions for even rape or incest.**The law also severely restricts abortion in cases where the patient’s health is at risk.**
That’s why nearly two dozen patients and doctors are suing Texas, arguing the medical exceptions to Texas’s abortion ban are far too narrow, putting patients’ lives at risk and preventing doctors from providing life-saving care.
But we can’t count on the courts to fully restore abortion rights. That’s why we are fighting every day to codify reproductive rights into federal law— for good.

| | | There’s no denying it: ** Bee populations are DROPPING in shocking numbers, and the consequences could be severe. Scientists are sounding the alarm – and warning of a catastrophic collapse of vital ecosystems **as insect populations decline.
---
**The Western bumblebee population has fallen by a staggering 93%. Over 700 types of North American bees are on the brink of EXTINCTION. Even honeybee colonies are declining at an alarming rate, with nearly 50% GONE just last year. But greedy corporations like Bayer are still polluting our farm fields – and contaminating the surrounding lands – by spreading MILLIONS OF POUNDS of bee-toxic pesticides. **
Our fragile bees don’t stand a chance against this senseless chemical onslaught. Meanwhile, the destructive and outdated pesticide industry continues to reap profits. **That’s why Friends of the Earth is fighting nonstop to protect our bees, our communities and our planet from harmful pesticide pollution and secure a sustainable future. But we need your help before Giving Tuesday ends so we can continue this urgent fight. **
**For today – and only today – a generous group of donors is matching all gifts up to $200,000 in honor of Giving Tuesday ****– ****but only until midnight TONIGHT. Neonics are the most widely used insecticides WORLDWIDE.** But these chemicals are **NEUROTOXIC to bees** , and research clearly shows that neonics are key drivers of an “insect apocalypse.”
**As bee populations keep dropping, risks to our food system – and our very survival – will continue to rise.** Neonics contamination persists in our food, soil and water – spreading its toxic touch from our farm fields into the wider ecosystem and our homes. Even more,** recent rates of bee loss have already impacted fruit, nut and vegetable production across the globe. That means more people could lose access to vital nutritious foods as they become more expensive, increasing the risk of heart disease, stroke and other life-threatening conditions, according to a recent study. **
But that isn’t stopping pesticide corporations from keeping their death grip on our farming system. **They’re spending big money on major misinformation campaigns in a huge effort to deceive farmers and consumers, and hide their role in the bee die-offs! body:
| The level of acceptable discourse in this country has never been lower — and it’s not only due to Donald Trump, but to powerful figures in the far-right media like Sean Hannity.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=4590%2E5257348%2EEc2MUo)
Derek, you may not know this about me, but I do a bit of moonlighting as a stand-up comic.
And trust me, I’m not giving up my day job.
So take it from me when I say, as the target of Sean Hannity’s stand-up set at the **Fox Nation Patriot Awards** show in Nashville, he’s a pretty lame comedian. Here he is, comparing my last name to “sh*t.” How original.
_“A lot of you complained to my bosses and you say 'Hannity curses on the air because he says it’s a complete sh*tshow.' But if you listen closely, I’m saying,**because Adam Schiff is a piece of sh*t, but if you say Schiff and sh*t together, you know, you can mix it up.** But I never said it wrong on TV. **I said it’s a complete Adam Schiff show.** ” — Sean Hannity_
I’m flattered, by the way. While simultaneously more than a little disturbed.
The level of acceptable discourse in this country has never been lower — and it’s not only due to Donald Trump, but to powerful figures in the far-right media like Sean Hannity.

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

| Anyone making a Gen X slacker joke never met Marc Molinaro. In 1995, at just 19, he became America’s youngest mayor – a position he held for six terms in upstate Tivoli, population 1,300.

“I fixed potholes and water main breaks, picked up garbage and built parks,” says Molinaro, a Republican elected last year to Congress. While his peers were pledging fraternities, he was steeped in zoning and economic policy: “Being a village mayor, you are the person people turn to, which is both challenging and fulfilling.”

Inspired by a high school program in Washington, D.C., Molinaro actually won his first election at 18, to the Tivoli Board of Trustees. Later, as a Dutchess County legislator, he wrote the Clean Indoor Air Act, which became a model for eliminating indoor smoking statewide.

After a stint as the Assembly’s assistant minority leader, Molinaro spent a dozen years as Dutchess County executive, working on criminal justice reform and building a model for a community-based mental health care. He ran for Congress “because I felt they could use some upstate common sense,” he says. “I felt they could use a village mayor.”

Three decades later, Molinaro draws daily on the lessons he learned back in Tivoli. “At that level, you see your decisions have real impact for real people,” he says.

“My generation has lived through a lot of history really quick, and it seems to be accelerating,” he says. “But I’ve cherished every second of my last 30 years in public service.”

– H.D.

| | Peter,

The campaign season is officially underway!

We're always communicating with our community in District 5. But in this stage of the race, there are always new people to introduce ourselves to and longtime residents who deserve updates on our progress. This early outreach is essential, and we need your support to make it happen— _**our End of Month Fundraising Deadline is in TWO DAYS, and we only need to raise $5,580 to reach our goal.**_

[Peter, reaching this early goal is critical to funding the early outreach we need to bring our community onto our team. In this work, your small-dollar contributions are all we can count on as the race gets underway. Can you help us reach our End of Month Fundraising Goal by donating $5, $10, $20 or whatever you're capable of today?](https://davidcanepa.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=46c1d4af8f9db208806c0d78a&id=9745d4620d&e=0961f0e7e8)

| When you elected me in 2016, we were in uncharted territory.

For the first time in San Mateo County history, we had the chance to represent our direct community through district-based elections. Prior to that, Supervisor seats were elected from the entire county. _**This meant that these Supervisor campaigns could be prohibitively costly, and locked out working-class people like us from having a chance.**_

We changed the course, and worked day and night to earn the privilege to represent our district on the Board. We knocked on thousands of doors, powered by a grassroots community ready to have our voices heard in our government. Since then, we've proudly worked to advocate for the working-class people that make San Mateo one of the greatest places to raise your family.

_**Now, we're back at it, and aren't changing course from our people-focused strategy of reaching folks wherever they are.**_

[Peter, we'll need you with us to power the canvassing and outreach necessary to earn this privilege once again. With our End of Month Fundraising Deadline fast approaching, we're counting on you to join us in continuing our work for San Mateo County. Can you chip in to our people-powered campaign today?](https://davidcanepa.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=46c1d4af8f9db208806c0d78a&id=bf716b8831&e=0961f0e7e8)

David Canepa

| | | | David Canepa is running for re-election to the San Mateo County Board of Supervisors to continue providing county residents with the resources and tools necessary to create a community that is healthy, environmentally conscious, equitable and economically prosperous.

As a fourth generation son of San Mateo County and graduate of Skyline College, David cares deeply about the residents of San Mateo County, as he has lived and worked in this community his entire life.

[](https://davidcanepa.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=46c1d4af8f9db208806c0d78a&id=6d3a449720&e=0961f0e7e8)

David is a proud fourth-generation San Mateo County and lives in Daly City with his family.

His extensive experience in public service includes serving two terms on the San Mateo County Board of Supervisors and as mayor and councilmember on the Daly City Council.

David serves on several regional boards and commissions tasked with improving traffic congestion and its impacts on the environment including the Metropolitan Transportation Commission, SamTrans and Commute.org.

He also serves on the San Mateo Medical Center and Health Plan of San Mateo boards with a mission to improve health outcomes for all county residents.

The end of the month has no official deadline. No FEC paperwork due. Don’t let anyone tell you different.
But campaigns are basically start-up organizations — we raise money over the span of 1-2 years, just so we have the support we need to reach new voters, hard-to-reach voters, and everyone in between. Campaigns end up spending the lion’s share of their resources in the last 3-5 months before the election, when they essentially shut down the start-up.
In order to do that effectively, you have to have a plan. And a plan has to have goals. Here on Team Slotkin, we have goals. Typically they are monthly goals, but we then further break that down into funds raised through emails, like this one, through texts, fundraising events, mail, etc.
So as this month comes to a close, we are all working to meet our monthly goal. This is where we hope you come in.
We're one of the few campaigns that will tell you that monthly deadlines aren’t real. There’s no make-or-break amount we need to raise before we file a report – that’s not until December 31. But we’d love your help meeting our November fundraising goals in order to stay on track toward our quarterly FEC deadlines.

clean_body: Despite fear-mongering by some politicians, fighting climate change and growing our economy aren’t mutually exclusive – in fact, they go hand-in-hand. | = | Peter, In a moment, I'm going to tell you how I've managed to lead on climate change while also growing local economies in communities across Washington, but first, I need to ask: = | = | = Despite fear-mongering by some politicians, fighting climate change and growing our economy aren’t mutually exclusive – in fact, they go hand-in-hand. The work I've done as Washington's Commissioner of Public Lands is proof. We’ve restored millions of acres of forests and underwater habitats, boosted new innovative industries like sustainable wood products and solar, and built infrastructure on the ground in every corner of the state. We utilized the state's natural resources to generate funds for school construction, support rural libraries, and aid emergency responders - creating thousands of good-paying jobs along the way. Now, with the opportunity to serve in Congress, I'm committed to continuing my work creating groundbreaking solutions, taking the policies we’ve pioneered in Washington state to the other Washington. By addressing our housing crisis, curbing rising costs, safeguarding our land and water, and expanding healthcare access, we can pave the way for a brighter future for all. = | = | = | = | = | = Thank you, Hilary Franz * | | = Paid for by Friends of Hilary Franz Friends of Hilary Franz PO Box 7437 Tacoma, WA 98417 United States | = Email is a critical way for our campaign to stay in touch with you. Kat Cammack is serving her second term representing the people of Northeastern Florida in Congress. She won the seat on a conservative platform of growing jobs, securing our southern border, standing up for law enforcement, defending our Second Amendment, promoting fiscal responsibility, and defending life.
Congresswoman Cammack sits on the House Committee on Energy and Commerce and House Committee on Agriculture, where she is the only Florida Republican serving the Sunshine State's farmers, ranchers, and producers. She was also appointed to the Select Subcommittee on the Weaponization of the Federal Government.

| Hi, Jane Fonda here.

subject: Final Chance: Manatees are choking and dying. Can their ocean habitats and planet count on you this Giving Tuesday?
body:

---|---|---

| | | **BEFORE GIVING TUESDAY ENDS:
YOUR MATCHED GIFT IS NEEDED TO PROTECT OUR OCEANS, COMMUNITIES AND EARTH **
---
| | [RUSH A GIFT](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2158153?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
Brace yourself, friend, this is serious. Last year, almost **ONE-SIXTH of Florida’s manatee population was DECIMATED by starvation and pollution. 2023 is on track to be another deadly year for these gentle creatures, with over 400 manatees having already perished since January. **
**Mega-polluting industries like Big Cruise fuel this tragedy with reckless dumping and massive quantities of CO2 emissions.** Cruise ships are STILL allowed to dump filthy, contaminated wastewater – including toxic, acidic wastewater – directly into ocean habitats that are critical for vulnerable species! This harmful pollution feeds destructive algae blooms that kill manatees' primary food source, seagrass. No wonder manatee deaths are spiking from painful starvation!
**But it gets worse. **Cruise ships never stop running, even when they dock – and they’re powered by some of the dirtiest heavy fuel. **Every day, a mid-sized cruise ship emits as much particulate pollution as ONE MILLION CARS.** Coastal communities are trapped, breathing in this harmful pollution and suffering higher rates of respiratory diseases as a result.
**We MUST hold cruise companies and other Big Polluters accountable for the damage they cause. That’s why Friends of the Earth urgently needs your support before Giving Tuesday ends. ****That's because right now, a generous group of donors is MATCHING every gift up to $200,000 – and we’re counting on supporters like you to make the most of this match before it expires at midnight TONIGHT.**
[](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2158153?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
[_Please, before midnight: Will you make a membership gift of $27 or more – and have it DOUBLED – to help Friends of the Earth fight corporate greed and protect our oceans, our people and our only Earth? _](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2158154?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

With pandemic travel restrictions lifted, **the cruise industry is BOOMING.** That means more ships – the size of city blocks – speeding through coastal waters and spewing their endless pollution. **The industry has grown so fast that governments have struggled to regulate it.** Greedy cruise companies have taken advantage of this situation, going beyond the huge quantities of LEGAL pollution to illegal dumping.
**Worse, some companies have SUED to block coastal communities from exercising their rights and protecting themselves from emissions-induced diseases! **No company should be able to take away our right to fight for our health and the health of our neighbors. For the sake of our oceans, our people and our planet, we MUST fight back.
**Friends of the Earth is standing up against the greedy cruise industry that prioritizes profits over human lives, helpless wildlife and the health of our planet. We are working to make sure proper regulations exist and are enforced for massive cruise ships.****Reaching our Giving Tuesday goal is critical to continuing this planet-saving work, and stopping ocean-wrecking, climate-destroying pollution from entering our ecosystems. But we rely on support from people like you, who understand how high the stakes are right now.**
**Please: We need your help to hit our goal and make the most of our rare Giving Tuesday match.**[Will you make your membership gift of $27 or more now – it will be MATCHED dollar for dollar – to help Friends of the Earth hold corporate polluters accountable and protect our oceans, our people and the only Earth we’ll ever get?](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2158154?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

| Peter,

In a moment, I’m going to ask you to split a donation of $10 to Upset the Setup and my campaign ahead of the end-of-month deadline. But first, I hope you’ll give me a moment to update you on all that is going on.

Not that long ago, Republicans took the step of censuring me in the House.

Censuring a representative is an extraordinary step — one that’s only been reserved for a few dozen times in our nation’s two-century history.

Their reason? Political retribution for exposing Donald Trump’s Russia and Ukraine misconduct and for holding him accountable during his first impeachment trial.

Kevin McCarthy backed the censure resolution to appease Trump and his MAGA members in Congress. In fact, Trump threatened to primary any Republican who voted against the resolution. Many Republican members who opposed it, then folded like a tent, and when the time came, the measure passed by a party-line vote.

Unfortunately, it’s clear the GOP still sees me as their biggest threat — because the attacks haven’t stopped. Just last week, Trump just attacked me in Iowa, now Sean Hannity and Kid Rock are piling on.

**As you can see, these MAGA attacks are getting more and more desperate by the day, Peter.** They know how effective I am, so they are prepared to throw every dirty trick in the book to sabotage my campaign for truth and justice — especially as the election gets closer.

subject: We should not be rubber-stamping Trump tax cuts for giant businesses.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
I’m doing everything I can to end these corporate tax breaks.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=1838%2E4032634%2EAfmq9s)
---
Donald Trump’s massive tax breaks for billionaires and giant corporations were bad enough — but now lobbyists are trying to make them even worse. You see, some of the corporate tax cuts in the 2017 law came with expiration dates. But here’s the thing: Republicans didn’t actually think those giveaways would expire. They added expiration dates to shrink their bill’s price tag, but they expected future Congresses to renew the tax breaks endlessly. Right on cue, as three of the biggest giveaways are starting to expire, corporate lobbyists are working overtime in Washington to get them extended. Not on my watch. **I’m fighting to make our country work for working people, not just the rich and powerful, and I’m doing everything I can to end these corporate tax breaks.** Now, lobbyists claimed that these three giant giveaways — bonus depreciation, R&D expensing, and the net interest deduction — were really important, because they’d spur American investment. But now we have data on how they’ve worked. Turns out, corporations used their extra cash to spend trillions on stock buybacks and dividends. So much for new investments. One more thing: like they did in 2017, and like they've done so many times before, corporate lobbyists are asking for a temporary extension of these tax breaks — to make them look cheaper than they actually are. But they have every intention of pushing Congress to extend these tax cuts again and again and again, so their wealthy clients will never actually have to pay the bill. Look, I get it: extending corporate tax breaks is really good for massive corporations. But it's really bad for the American people. We should not be rubber-stamping Trump tax cuts for giant businesses. **I’ll keep doing everything in my power to make sure millionaires, billionaires, and giant corporations are paying their fair share.** Last year, Congress passed my minimum tax on massive corporate profits, and I’m running for re-election to stay in the fight for plans like a wealth tax on fortunes greater than $50 million. I’m also working to end lobbying as we know it so big money won’t have so much power in Washington. [**And I’m able to stay in these fights because I’m shoulder to shoulder with people like you. Can you help grow our grassroots campaign and support my re-election with a donation of $28 or any amount?**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/992?amount=28&t=8&akid=1838%2E4032634%2EAfmq9s)

#

Peter, we’re writing to you this evening to ask you to make a donation to Ruben Gallego’s campaign for Senate in Arizona.
Please, let us explain why your donation is so important.
**FIRST:** Just last month, Kari Lake entered the race. After losing her campaign for governor by less than one percent, she’s running as the “MAGA Queen” and wants to bring her extremist views with her to the Senate.

clean_body: I call out BS when I see it. | Hi — I’m well aware of what the pundits are saying about our race. That Tennessee isn’t a state where Democrats can compete, so why are we even trying? But you and I know that’s BS. Election after election has proven that when people come together, change is possible. We can flip this seat for Democrats and elect a Senator who cares about every Tennessean, but only with your help. I will ALWAYS be honest with you, so here’s one thing the pundits do get right: This won’t be an easy race to win. I can’t defeat Marsha by myself. With a heck of a lot of grassroots enthusiasm and YOUR financial support, we can build the kind of campaign that can take Marsha on. That’s why I need your help right now. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | = | = ---|--- = | = = | = I’m standing tall to take on Marsha Blackburn because, after two decades in Washington, it’s clear that she’s in office for her corporate donors and special interests — NOT for us. But thanks to them, Marsha has a campaign war chest dedicated to funding her re-election campaign. Look, I’m not saying this’ll be an easy race to win. I know it’ll be hard as hell.
